copropriete.title: Luxembourg co-ownership: law 16.05.1975, syndic, AGM, fund 2026
copropriete.metaDescription: LU co-ownership 2026: mandatory syndic above 5 lots, general meeting, notarial regulations, shares (tantièmes), mandatory reserve fund, graduated voting majorities, syndical council.
copropriete.subtitle: How a co-ownership works in Luxembourg: bodies, voting rules, charges and legal obligations.
essentiel: Legal framework: modified law of 16 May 1975 on co-ownership of built properties (2018 reform, mandatory reserve fund).
Professional syndic mandatory above 5 lots, 3-year renewable term, executes the GM's decisions.
Shares (tantièmes) defined in the notarial co-ownership regulations: govern BOTH voting rights AND charge allocation.
Graduated majorities: simple (maintenance), absolute (improvement), 3/4 (transformation/regulation), unanimity (impact on private rights).
Mandatory reserve fund (2018 reform) to anticipate facade, roof and elevator works.
copropriete.section1P1: Co-ownership applies once a built property is divided among several owners into lots, each comprising a private part (apartment, cellar, parking) and a share of common parts (structure, roof, stairs, collective equipment). Each co-owner is by right a member of the co-owners' association, a legal person owning and managing the common parts (Art. 9, 1975 modified law).
copropriete.section1P2: Three bodies structure governance: the syndic (executive agent, professional mandatory above 5 lots), the general meeting (sovereign body voting budget, works and the syndic's status) and the syndical council (optional body of elected co-owners overseeing management). The association is represented in court by the syndic, but the regulations may provide delegations.
copropriete.callout1Body: For co-ownerships of 5 lots or fewer, appointing a professional syndic is not mandatory (Art. 16). Co-owners may appoint one of themselves as a volunteer syndic, or do without a syndic and manage directly (with a yearly GM nonetheless). No mandatory reserve fund either, but advisable.
copropriete.section2P1: The syndic is the association's legal agent. Main missions: convene the annual GM (at least once a year, Art. 14), execute voted decisions, keep the association's accounts, collect charges and capital calls, contract necessary services (insurance, maintenance, elevator service), keep archives and the co-owners' register, represent the association in court.
copropriete.section2P2: The professional syndic's mandate is limited to 3 years renewable (Art. 17). They must hold an establishment authorisation and professional liability insurance. Remuneration includes flat-rate fees (current management) and separately invoiced specific services. Any co-owner may inspect the accounting and technical files on simple request.
copropriete.section3P1: The annual ordinary GM votes on the past year's accounts, the forecast budget, the syndic's discharge and the works programme. An extraordinary GM may be convened anytime by the syndic or upon request of co-owners holding at least 25% of shares. The notice must be sent by registered letter 21 days before the meeting with the agenda, draft budget and necessary documents (Art. 14).
copropriete.section3P2: Required majorities are graduated by the gravity of the decision: simple majority (50% + 1 of present or represented shares) for routine decisions (budget, maintenance, ordinary expenses); absolute majority (50% + 1 of all shares) for improvement works and the syndic's appointment/removal; 3/4 majority of all shares for amendments to the regulations, transformation works, change of purpose; unanimity for any impact on private rights (lot removal, share modification).
copropriete.callout2Body: An absent co-owner may give proxy to another co-owner or a third party. A single proxy holder cannot hold more than one fifth of the shares (Art. 14 para. 4) to avoid concentrations of power. The syndic cannot hold any proxy. Check the regulations, which may impose stricter rules.
copropriete.section4P1: Since the 2018 law reform, a reserve fund is mandatory for co-ownerships with more than 5 lots. The minimum annual contribution is set by the GM (often 5 to 10% of the annual budget) and must fund upcoming major works (facade renovation every 15-20 years, roof, elevator, EPBD energy compliance). The fund is inalienable: it cannot serve any purpose other than works voted at the GM.
copropriete.section4P2: Current charges (maintenance, common utilities, insurance, syndic) are allocated by shares. Some specific charges may follow different keys provided in the regulations: e.g., elevator only to floors served, collective heating prorated to heated area, water prorated to individual consumption. The syndic issues quarterly capital calls and an annual statement.
copropriete.callout3Body: In case of persistent default, the syndic can initiate recovery proceedings after formal notice. The association has a first-rank real estate privilege on the defaulting co-owner's lot for the current two years' charges (Art. 24). The recalcitrant co-owner can be sued before the justice of the peace, and as a last resort the lot can be sold at forced auction.

faq.q: Is a syndic mandatory in Luxembourg co-ownerships?
faq.a: Yes, appointing a professional syndic is mandatory for co-ownerships with more than 5 lots (Art. 16 of the modified 1975 law). For small co-ownerships (≤ 5 lots), management can be ensured directly by co-owners or by a volunteer syndic.

faq.q: What majority is needed to vote on works in a co-ownership?
faq.a: Routine maintenance: simple majority. Improvement works: absolute majority. Amendment of regulations or transformation works: 3/4 majority of all shares. Impact on private rights: unanimity.

faq.q: How much should be put aside in the reserve fund?
faq.a: The law sets no percentage, but the GM must vote a realistic annual contribution to fund upcoming major works. In practice, allow 5 to 10% of the annual current budget. For an old building, up to 15% may be needed to anticipate facade and roof works.

faq.q: What happens if a co-owner does not pay?
faq.a: The syndic sends a formal notice and can refer the matter to the justice of the peace. The association has a first-rank real estate privilege on the lot for the current two years' charges (Art. 24). As a last resort, the lot can be sold at forced auction to clear the debt.

faq.q: How to change the syndic in Luxembourg?
faq.a: At the end of the 3-year term, the GM votes the appointment of a new syndic by absolute majority. During the term, dismissal is possible by absolute majority for serious fault (mismanagement, non-compliance with GM decisions, conflict of interest). The dismissed syndic must transfer archives and treasury within 15 days.

faq.q: Is the syndical council mandatory?
faq.a: No, it is an optional body. Composed of co-owners elected at the GM, it assists and oversees the syndic, advises on important contracts and prepares GMs. Strongly recommended once a co-ownership has more than 10 lots to avoid total dependence on the syndic.

klimabonus.title: Klimabonus 2026: conditions and procedures
klimabonus.subtitle: Prepare an energy application and budget without counting unconfirmed assistance.
klimabonus.section1P1: Klimabonus 2026 supports qualifying energy measures in residential buildings. For building-envelope renovation, the building must notably be more than ten years old from the building-permit date. Conditions depend on the measure and application dates.
klimabonus.section1P2: Owner-occupiers are not the only applicants: landlords and certain groups or legal entities may also apply. A dwelling, hotel and commercial building must not automatically be treated as eligible under the same scheme.
klimabonus.callout1Body: Older applications may remain under an earlier scheme. Check the procedure for the measure and its dates; a reform announcement is not a grant award.
klimabonus.section3P1: Distinguish free introductory Klima-Agence advice from an accredited adviser’s technical assignment, which may be charged and subsidised subject to conditions. Works cost or a CPE class improvement alone cannot calculate a grant.
klimabonus.section3P2: For renovation with energy advice, obtain approval in principle before works begin. A separate procedure exists for a single measure without full advice. Prepare quotes, areas, performance data and evidence, then follow the chosen scheme’s deadlines.
klimabonus.section4P1: Separate grants, VAT relief and bank financing. Cumulation depends on each scheme’s rules. A loan must be repaid; it does not reduce economic cost like a grant. A grant paid after works does not immediately fund a deposit.
klimabonus.callout3Body: With €100,000 total including VAT and €20,000 of confirmed grants, net cost is €80,000. If grants arrive in year 1, initial funding is still €100,000 before borrowing. VAT relief already included in the price must not be deducted again.

faq.q: Is the works budget enough to calculate Klimabonus?
faq.a: Measures, areas, materials, performance, equipment and dates determine the rates. Total cost alone cannot produce a reliable calculation.

faq.q: Is energy advice always free?
faq.a: Distinguish free introductory Klima-Agence advice from an accredited adviser’s technical assignment, which may be charged and subsidised subject to conditions. Works cost or a CPE class improvement alone cannot calculate a grant.

faq.q: Does a climate loan guarantee a 0% rate?
faq.a: Financing and subsidy must be assessed with the bank and housing office. A loan is not a grant and does not guarantee a 1.5% bank rate.

faq.q: Can I deduct reduced VAT again?
faq.a: 14% of eligible net works, within the remaining €50,000 allowance per dwelling, shared between construction and renovation. Do not deduct from an already reduced price again.

estimation.title: Luxembourg real estate valuation: TEGOVA EVS 2025 methods
estimation.metaDescription: Property valuation LU: 3 TEGOVA approaches (comparison, capitalisation, DCF), Observatory/STATEC/AED data sources, LISER hedonic model, EPC impact 3 to 8%/class, REV/TRV.
estimation.subtitle: How to properly value a property in Luxembourg: professional methods, available data and 2026 valuation drivers.
essentiel: 3 TEGOVA EVS 2025 approaches: direct comparison (residential), income capitalisation (rental), DCF (commercial / hospitality).
LU data: LISER Housing Observatory, STATEC IPIR, AED land registry (actual prices), real estate portals, consulting firm reports (JLL, CBRE, C&W).
Key drivers: location (x2-x4 spread LU City vs rural), area, condition, EPC (3-8% value/class), outdoor spaces and parking.
Recognised bases of value: Market Value, Investment Value, Fair Value (IFRS 13). TEGOVA report sets out assumptions and conditions.
Professional expertise: REV (Recognised European Valuer) or TRV (TEGOVA Residential Valuer), guaranteeing independence and method.
estimation.section1P1: Direct comparison (Sales Comparison) is most used for residential: analysis of recent transactions on similar properties in the same area, adjusted for differences (area, floor, condition, orientation, parking, EPC). Reliable method when the market offers comparable references. In Luxembourg, LISER feeds this approach via hedonic models that isolate each characteristic's contribution to price.
estimation.section1P2: Income Capitalisation divides stabilised net annual rental income by a capitalisation rate reflecting market risk and return. LU residential cap rates: 3 to 5% by location and asset class. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach projects cash flows over 10-15 years and discounts them at a suitable WACC (typically 5-9%), with a terminal value; mandatory for commercial and hospitality assets per EVS 2025.
estimation.callout1Body: TEGOVA EVS 2025 standards require the valuer to justify the method and, where possible, cross-check with a secondary approach. In practice, on a residential rental property, you combine direct comparison (price reference) and capitalisation (yield consistency). If both converge within ±5%, the value is robust.
estimation.section2P1: The LU market has high-quality public sources: Housing Observatory (observatoire.liser.lu) — transaction prices by municipality and type, rent index, monthly tracking; STATEC — IPIR (Residential Property Price Index), construction price index, demographics; data.public.lu — geoportal data, cadastre, PAG/PAP plans; AED land registry — notarial sale deeds (actual prices published quarterly).
estimation.section2P2: For tertiary (offices, retail, hotels): quarterly reports from international firms JLL, CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield, Inowai (prime rents, vacancy rates, observed yields). For regulated rental valuation: the tevaxia legal rent calculator automates the 5% rule with STATEC coefficients. For hotels: STATEC overnight stays observatory, RevPAR by category.
estimation.section3P1: The price/sqm spread between LU areas can be x4: Luxembourg City Centre (€15,000-20,000/sqm) vs rural cantons (€4,000-6,000/sqm). Within a municipality, sub-neighbourhoods differ (school proximity, transport, green areas, retail). Living area and layout matter (T2-T3 value better per sqm than T6+ for the rental market).
estimation.section3P2: General condition and finish quality: a renovated property is valued 10-20% above an equivalent property to renovate. Energy performance has a growing impact: LISER studies put the value spread per EPC class at 3-8% (an F→C jump can boost value by 10-25%). Outdoor spaces (garden, terrace, balcony) and parking typically add 10-15% of value. Orientation, quietness and floor (with elevator) also play a role.
estimation.callout2Body: With the revised EU EPBD directive and upcoming renovation obligations (G/F classes banned for rental from 2030 in some countries), EPC impact on value will amplify. Anticipate by integrating energy renovation into the investment business plan, especially for E-G class properties.
estimation.section4P1: European Valuation Standards 2025 (TEGOVA) define internationally recognised bases of value: Market Value (hypothetical arms-length cash transaction at the valuation date), Investment Value (value to a specific investor under their criteria), Fair Value (IFRS 13 fair value for audited accounts), Mortgage Lending Value (prudent mortgage value for banks).
estimation.section4P2: Any professional TEGOVA valuation report sets out: the basis of value, the method(s) applied, data sources, key assumptions and special conditions (subject to resolutory condition, renovation to be completed, etc.). In Luxembourg, REV or TRV certified experts (by the national INREV institute) guarantee compliance with these standards and put their professional liability on the line.
estimation.callout3Title: When to commission a REV expertise?
estimation.callout3Body: A REV/TRV expertise is required for: a complex bank financing dossier, an estate or gift with division, expropriation, divorce with patrimony division, a court dispute. For a simple sale between private parties, an estimate by 2-3 real estate agents or a hedonic tool (like tevaxia) is generally sufficient.

faq.q: What is the most reliable method for valuing a property in Luxembourg?
faq.a: For residential, direct comparison combined with a hedonic model is the most reliable. For rental, income capitalisation is preferred. For commercial/hospitality, DCF is the standard. TEGOVA EVS 2025 recommend cross-checking at least two methods to strengthen reliability.

faq.q: Does the EPC affect property prices in Luxembourg?
faq.a: Yes. LISER studies put the value spread per EPC class at 3-8% (a class F to C jump can value 10-25% more). Impact will grow with European energy renovation obligations (EPBD revised 2024).

faq.q: How much does a REV/TRV expertise cost in Luxembourg?
faq.a: For a residential property, expect €800 to €2,500 depending on complexity. For a commercial or hospitality asset, €3,000 to €15,000 by value and complexity. Fees are unregulated, based on time spent and liability assumed. The TEGOVA report is recognised by banks and courts.

faq.q: Where to find actual sale prices in Luxembourg?
faq.a: The Land Registry (AED) publishes actual prices of notarial deeds quarterly. The LISER Housing Observatory aggregates and publishes these data by municipality and property type (observatoire.liser.lu).

faq.q: What is the typical capitalisation rate in Luxembourg?
faq.a: For residential: 3 to 5% gross by location (3-3.5% in prime LU City zones, 4-5% in cantons). For prime LU City offices: 4 to 5%. For hospitality: 6 to 8% by category and performance. These rates evolve with policy rates and bond yields.

faq.q: Should VAT be considered in the estimate?
faq.a: For new VEFA, value is typically presented excluding VAT then converted to TTC at the applicable rate (3% housing VAT with €50,000 cap). For existing (between private parties), no VAT but registration duties owed by the buyer. TEGOVA reports always distinguish excl./incl. VAT.

achatNonResident.title: Buying property in Luxembourg as non-resident: 2026 guide
achatNonResident.metaDescription: Non-resident property purchase LU 2026: no restrictions, 7% duties + Bëllegen Akt if primary residence, 70-75% bank LTV, tax treaties, 100F return for rental income.
achatNonResident.subtitle: Everything to buy property in Luxembourg as a non-resident: taxation, financing, declarations and worked examples.
essentiel: No nationality or residency restrictions: any foreigner can buy in Luxembourg, in full ownership.
Bëllegen Akt accessible if the property serves as the non-resident's actual primary residence (€40,000 per buyer, €80,000 per couple).
LU bank financing for non-residents: typical 70-75% LTV (vs 80-100% resident), 25-30% deposit required.
LU taxation on LU-source rental income and capital gains. Tax treaty with country of residence prevents double taxation.
Mandatory model 100F return in Luxembourg for net rental income.
achatNonResident.section1P1: Luxembourg imposes no nationality or residency restriction for the acquisition of property on its territory. A French, Belgian, German, British, American or other national can buy in full ownership an apartment, house, land or commercial premises in the Grand Duchy, under the same legal conditions as a Luxembourg resident.
achatNonResident.section1P2: The acquisition deed is signed before a Luxembourg notary, who ensures all formalities are met (mortgage clearances, possible municipal pre-emption, town planning compliance). The property is registered with the national land registry. Subsequent management (rental, resale) follows Luxembourg law, regardless of the owner's place of residence.
achatNonResident.callout1Title: Remote purchase: representation by power of attorney
achatNonResident.callout1Body: The non-resident can sign the sale agreement and the authentic deed remotely via a notarial power of attorney granted to a relative, a lawyer or the notary's clerk. The power of attorney must be apostilled if signed outside the EU. Several LU notarial offices offer end-to-end packages for foreign buyers.
achatNonResident.section2P1: Registration duties (6% + 1% transcription = 7%) apply identically to residents and non-residents. The Bëllegen Akt (€40,000 per buyer, €80,000 per couple) remains accessible to non-residents PROVIDED the acquired property effectively serves as the new buyer's primary residence, with a commitment to move in within two years. This is consistent with the scheme's objective: making access to a primary residence easier, including for new residents.
achatNonResident.section2P2: For a buy-to-let investment (the property is rented to a third party, not occupied by the buyer), Bëllegen Akt is not accessible: the full 7% duties are due. The non-resident is taxed in Luxembourg only on Luxembourg-source income (rental income from the LU property, LU capital gains) at the IR progressive rate.
achatNonResident.callout2Body: Luxembourg has signed bilateral tax treaties with France, Belgium, Germany, the UK, the US and most OECD countries. For real estate, the principle is taxation in the country of location (so Luxembourg). The taxpayer's country of residence then grants a tax credit or exempts the already-taxed LU income to avoid double taxation.
achatNonResident.section3P1: Luxembourg banks (Spuerkeess, BIL, BGL BNP Paribas, Raiffeisen, ING Luxembourg) accept financing non-residents, with conditions slightly stricter than for first-time resident buyers. The typical LTV ratio for a non-resident is 70-75% (25-30% deposit required), versus 80-100% for a resident in primary residence.
achatNonResident.section3P2: Maximum loan term may be shortened (20-25 years instead of 30) depending on the borrower's age. Interest rates are comparable to those for residents (typically +0.2 to 0.5% margin possible). Documents required: 3 last tax assessments, 6 last payslips, employment contract, 3 months of bank statements, detailed financing plan. For a buy-to-let, the bank assesses the DSTI (Debt Service to Income) ratio including 70-80% of expected rent.

faq.q: Can a non-resident benefit from Bëllegen Akt?
faq.a: Yes, provided the acquired property effectively serves as the new buyer's primary residence, with a commitment to move in personally within 2 years of the deed. For a pure buy-to-let, Bëllegen Akt is not accessible and the full 7% duties are due.

faq.q: What is the minimum deposit for a non-resident in Luxembourg?
faq.a: LU banks generally require a 25-30% deposit for non-residents (LTV 70-75%), versus sometimes 0-20% for residents in primary residence. The ratio varies by bank, borrower profile and property location.

faq.q: What documents to provide to the LU bank as a non-resident?
faq.a: ID, last 3 tax assessments from the country of residence, last 6 payslips, employment contract, 3 months of bank statements, proof of deposit, detailed financing plan. For a buy-to-let, add the sale agreement and rental estimate.

faq.q: How does the France-Luxembourg tax treaty work for real estate?
faq.a: The 2018 France-Luxembourg treaty provides that property income and capital gains from a property in LU are taxable in LU. France exempts them but retains them to compute the global effective tax rate. You pay LU income tax on these, with no double taxation.

faq.q: Do I need a LU bank account to buy?
faq.a: Not mandatory for the deed (the notary accepts a transfer from abroad), but strongly recommended for subsequent management: rent collection, charges and tax payment, mortgage drawdowns. Several LU banks open a non-resident account within a few days.

faq.q: What annual taxes does a non-resident owner pay?
faq.a: Municipal property tax (modest, 0.1 to 1% of cadastral value), income tax on net rental income if rented (LU IR scale with deductions), possibly capital gains tax on resale before the exemption period. No wealth tax in Luxembourg.

tva3Pourcent.title: Luxembourg 3 % housing VAT: conditions and AED procedure 2026
tva3Pourcent.metaDescription: Housing VAT: EUR 50,000 benefit, principal residence, creation or renovation and two tax-authority procedures. Verifiable capped examples.
tva3Pourcent.subtitle: Housing VAT concerns eligible works used for a principal residence under the amended regulation of 30 July 2002. It is not a general reduction of a home’s purchase price.
essentiel: The benefit is limited to EUR 50,000 per dwelling. At rates of 17% and 3%, the theoretical saving is 14% of the eligible net base, capped by the remaining allowance. VAT payable is standard VAT minus that benefit. A change of owner does not mean the full allowance is available again: check the property’s record with the tax authority.

Since 2015, the benefit for creation is reserved for the owner’s principal home. Creation includes construction, conversion into housing and extensions. Renovation may also concern a third party’s principal home, such as a tenant’s. A second home does not meet the required use.
tva3Pourcent.section1P1: Housing VAT concerns eligible works used for a principal residence under the amended regulation of 30 July 2002. It is not a general reduction of a home’s purchase price.
tva3Pourcent.section1P2: The benefit is limited to EUR 50,000 per dwelling. At rates of 17% and 3%, the theoretical saving is 14% of the eligible net base, capped by the remaining allowance. tva3Pourcent.callout1Body: For mixed use, the tax authority’s brochure grants the benefit on the whole when the principal-residence area exceeds three quarters of the total; at three quarters or less, it is proportional to the relevant area. tva3Pourcent.section2P2: The tax authority distinguishes renovation within five years of acquisition regardless of age, and renovation of a dwelling at least ten years old. The label “renovation” alone is insufficient: check the category, works and applicable deadlines. Furniture, fitted kitchens and notarial, architectural or consulting-engineer fees are among the exclusions from the housing VAT scheme. Use and occupation must satisfy the scheme’s conditions. bailCommercial.title: Luxembourg commercial lease: law 03.02.2018, 9-year term
bailCommercial.metaDescription: LU commercial lease: law 03.02.2018, 9-year minimum term, triennial termination 6-month notice, STATEC CPI indexation, free key money, renewal right, eviction compensation.
bailCommercial.subtitle: The complete legal framework for commercial leases in Luxembourg: term, termination, rent, indexation and renewal right.
essentiel: Legal framework: law of 3 February 2018 on commercial leases (in force since 1 April 2018), modernising the prior Civil-Code-only regime.
Minimum 9-year term (Art. 2). Triennial termination by tenant (3, 6, 9 years) with 6 months' notice.
Free rent (no 5% rule), STATEC CPI indexation if explicit clause, triennial review possible if rent diverges from rental value.
Key money (pas-de-porte) lawful and unregulated: freely negotiated between landlord and tenant.
Renewal right at term; refusal without legitimate grounds = eviction compensation (loss of clientele, moving costs, business goodwill).
bailCommercial.section1P1: Commercial leases in Luxembourg have been governed since 1 April 2018 by the law of 3 February 2018 on commercial leases. This law replaced the application of the Civil Code alone and modernised the framework: minimum legal term, renewal right, eviction compensation, regulated indexation. It applies to leases of premises used for a commercial, craft or industrial activity carried out professionally.
bailCommercial.section1P2: Excluded: residential leases (law of 21.09.2006), agricultural leases (specific regime), leases of intangible assets (business goodwill without premises), and short-term leases (< 6 months for seasonal activities). The lease must be in writing (preferable but not mandatory); without writing, evidence of occupation and payment proves the lease's existence but with a heavier burden of proof in case of dispute.
bailCommercial.callout1Body: The 2018 law only protects leases where the tenant effectively operates a commercial activity at the leased address (trade register, signage, clientele). A simple domiciliation or office use without clientele does not suffice to invoke the commercial lease protection.
bailCommercial.section2P1: The legal minimum term is 9 years (Art. 2). Parties may agree a longer term (e.g., 12, 15 or 25 years for major fit-out investments), but never shorter. If the lease provides less than 9 years, the term is automatically extended to 9 years by law.
bailCommercial.section2P2: The tenant has a triennial termination right: they may end the lease at the expiry of each 3-year period (3, 6, 9 years) with 6 months' notice served by extrajudicial act or registered letter (Art. 4). The landlord, however, may only terminate during the lease for limitatively listed reasons: serious tenant breach, personal business need, or full demolition/reconstruction works.
bailCommercial.section3P1: Commercial rent is NOT capped by the 5% rule (which applies only to residential leases). It is freely set between parties according to market conditions and the premises' rental value. For LU commercial premises, prime LU City rents typically range from €80 to €250/sqm/month depending on location and use.
bailCommercial.section3P2: Indexation is linked to the Consumer Price Index (CPI) published by STATEC. The indexation clause must be expressly provided in the lease; otherwise, rent remains fixed throughout. Rent review may be requested by either party at the end of each 3-year period if the rent no longer corresponds to actual rental value (Art. 7). Key money (pas-de-porte) is lawful in Luxembourg, in exchange for the location's commercial advantages, and is freely negotiated.
bailCommercial.callout2Body: Unlike France, which has a specific Commercial Rent Index (ILC), Luxembourg uses the general CPI. This may decorrelate commercial rent from actual market conditions. Anticipate by possibly requesting an annual indexation cap in the lease drafting.
bailCommercial.section4P1: The commercial tenant has a lease renewal right at term (Art. 5). It is exercised by notifying the landlord of a renewal request at least 6 months before the term. A landlord refusing renewal without legitimate grounds must pay the tenant eviction compensation covering the loss: clientele loss, moving and reinstallation costs, business goodwill loss compensation.
bailCommercial.section4P2: The landlord may refuse renewal without compensation only for serious grounds: tenant's contractual or legal breach, building condition requiring full demolition and reconstruction, or personal business need (the landlord must then operate the premises in the same or related activity for at least 2 years). Assignment of the commercial lease is possible unless otherwise stipulated, generally tied to the goodwill assignment; the landlord must be informed.
bailCommercial.callout3Body: Assigning the commercial lease to a third party (notably on goodwill sale) is free unless expressly forbidden by the lease. Partial subletting is more constrained and generally requires the landlord's written consent. Any assignment must be notified to them. If the lease bans assignment, foresee an exit clause for goodwill resale.

faq.q: What is the minimum term of a commercial lease in Luxembourg?
faq.a: 9 years (Art. 2 of the law of 3 February 2018). The tenant may terminate at each triennial period (3, 6, 9 years) with 6 months' notice. The landlord may only terminate for serious breach, personal business need or demolition/reconstruction.

faq.q: Is commercial rent capped in Luxembourg?
faq.a: No, unlike residential leases (5% cap on invested capital), commercial rent is freely set between parties. Indexation uses STATEC CPI if an express clause provides for it.

faq.q: What is key money and how to negotiate it?
faq.a: Key money (pas-de-porte) is an initial payment by the tenant to the landlord in exchange for the location's commercial advantages. Lawful in LU, unregulated, freely negotiated (typically 1 to 6 months' rent for an average location, up to several years for prime). Can be amortised by the tenant over the lease term.

faq.q: How does the renewal right work?
faq.a: The tenant notifies a renewal request at least 6 months before the lease term. A landlord refusing without legitimate grounds (breach, demolition, personal business need) must pay eviction compensation covering clientele loss, moving and goodwill loss. The amount is set amicably or by a judge.

faq.q: Can the landlord block the lease assignment to a buyer?
faq.a: No, unless an opposite clause in the lease. Commercial lease assignment is free, generally tied to the goodwill assignment. The landlord must be informed but cannot oppose if the lease conditions (rent, use) are respected by the buyer. Provide an approval clause if the landlord wants oversight.

faq.q: What to do in case of serious tenant breach?
faq.a: The landlord sends a formal notice by registered letter specifying the breach (unpaid rent > 2 months, prohibited subletting, change of use, major damage). Without remedy within 30 days, the landlord can refer the matter to court for judicial termination with eviction and arrears/damages claim.

sources.title: Law of 3 February 2018 on commercial leases

investirHotel.title: Investing in a Luxembourg hotel: evidence, calculations and checks
investirHotel.metaDescription: Prepare a hotel investment with tourism sources, ADR and RevPAR, a defined valuation scope, debt coverage and due diligence evidence.
investirHotel.subtitle: Link project figures to their evidence, distinguish performance measures and prepare checks before acquisition.
essentiel: Retain evidence, dates and the tax scope of each figure.
Calculate ADR, occupancy and RevPAR over the same period.
Distinguish property, operations and shares in comparables.
Obtain the lender’s financing definitions and conditions.
Check permits and aid conditions for the actual project.
investirHotel.section1P1: Start with property records: available rooms by day, rooms sold, accommodation revenue, other income and expenses. Retain dates, accounting evidence and VAT treatment. Guest nights are not the same as rooms sold.
investirHotel.section1P2: Compare matching periods and scopes. Examine seasonality using the property history and document closures, works and changes in activity. National statistics alone cannot predict the revenue of a particular hotel or neighbourhood.
investirHotel.callout1Body: The Tevaxia observatory presents Eurostat series for hotels and similar accommodation in Luxembourg (NACE I55.1). Check the period and measure for each series. These observations do not provide your hotel’s ADR, RevPAR or transaction price. The comparison tool uses the data and references you enter.
investirHotel.section2P1: For the same period: occupancy = sold room nights / available room nights; ADR = accommodation revenue / sold room nights; RevPAR = accommodation revenue / available room nights. RevPAR = ADR × occupancy when the underlying bases match. Without a positive denominator, the ratio is undefined.
investirHotel.section2P2: Define the accounting scope before reconciling GOP, EBITDA and cash flow. Identify rent, management fees and other expenses; a replacement reserve is different from depreciation. Use accounts and contracts to explain adjustments. This guide assumes no margin or target return.
investirHotel.section3Title: Value the asset and prepare financing
investirHotel.section3P1: Distinguish the property, operating business and company shares. For income capitalisation, substantiate annual income and the chosen rate. For transactions per room, check the date, rights sold and costs included. A DCF requires documented cash flows, discount rate and exit; its duration is not a universal standard.
investirHotel.section3P2: DSCR compares cash available for debt with debt service over the same period, using the lender’s definition. Include principal repayment and interest according to the schedule. Obtain the bank’s definitions, thresholds, security and conditions: a Tevaxia calculation is not a financing approval.
investirHotel.callout2Title: E‑2: investment in the United States
investirHotel.callout2Body: Luxembourg is on the US list of E‑2 treaty countries. This visa concerns investment in a business in the United States. Buying a hotel located in Luxembourg does not by itself meet that condition. Luxembourg residence permission is a separate procedure; a Tevaxia file does not establish immigration eligibility.
investirHotel.section4P1: Reconcile accounts, bookings, receipts and operating contracts. Have the title or lease, building condition, equipment, applicable permits and priced works reviewed. The due diligence list records evidence and open issues; it is not a compliance certificate.
investirHotel.section4P2: Guichet.lu distinguishes the operator’s business permit from hotelier status allowing certain business designations. Check the activities actually conducted and their permits. Identify the applicable aid scheme and conditions before committing to works; the cited environmental aid requires application before work starts. No grant amount is assumed in the budget.
investirHotel.callout3Body: Teaching assumptions, not market observations: 10 available rooms for 365 days give 3,650 room nights. Selling 1,825 room nights at an ADR of €100 excluding VAT gives accommodation revenue of €182,500 excluding VAT, 50% occupancy and €50 RevPAR. These figures alone determine neither EBITDA, value nor debt repayment capacity.

tools.title: Documented hotel debt coverage
tools.description: Fixed-rate amortising loan, monthly payments and declared annual available cash flow. No bank threshold, credit refusal or downside scenario is assumed.

tools.title: Hotel activity in Luxembourg — Eurostat
tools.description: Official monthly series for Luxembourg: hotels and similar accommodation (NACE I55.1), residents and non-residents combined. National data describes neither an individual hotel nor a star category.

tools.title: Documented hotel acquisition
tools.description: Cash flow analysis of an acquisition project. No market price, sector multiple, growth or purchase score is assumed. Each amount and year requires supporting evidence.

faq.q: Which RevPAR should I use?
faq.a: Calculate it from accommodation revenue and available room nights over a defined period. This guide supplies no market average applicable to every hotel.

faq.q: What DSCR must be achieved?
faq.a: The threshold and cash flow definition depend on the project and lender. Confirm the conditions; no ratio guarantees credit.

faq.q: Which EBITDA multiple should I use?
faq.a: Use references with a documented scope, date and adjustments. No Luxembourg sector multiple is assumed here.

faq.q: What price per room should I use?
faq.a: Compare documented transactions and identify whether the price includes property, operations, shares or costs. Price per room alone does not establish value.

faq.q: Does a Luxembourg hotel qualify for an E‑2 visa?
faq.a: The purchase alone does not qualify: the E‑2 visa concerns a business in the United States. Luxembourg is a treaty country; eligible nationality does not replace the other requirements.

faq.q: How should renovation aid be included?
faq.a: Identify the applicable scheme and conditions with the relevant authority. Distinguish requested aid from awarded aid and its payment conditions; do not deduct an assumed subsidy from works costs.

faq.q: Which models are supported in BYOK?
faq.a: Anthropic (Claude 4.x — recommended for PDF vision and EVS drafting), OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo — strong vision), Groq (fast Llama 3.x), Google Gemini (3.6 Flash — free, default). 2-click setup in /profil. Unit costs displayed in real time.

faq.q: How to access the public tevaxia API?
faq.a: On /api-docs you'll find full documentation of the 3 endpoints (analyze, chat, extract) with cURL examples, JS and Python SDK. Authentication via X-API-Key header. Standard rate-limit tier is free; for high volumes or SLA, contact us via /pricing for an enterprise tier.

faq.q: What are the AI analysis limits?
faq.a: Models occasionally make calculation errors or cite outdated references (knowledge cutoff varies by model). tevaxia injects up-to-date key figures (2026 rates, STATEC coefficients, Bëllegen Akt amounts) into the context to reduce these errors. For critical figures, always verify with our deterministic tools (calculators, simulators).

strForecast.title: Monthly short-stay projection
strForecast.subtitle: Scenario for one unit available every calendar day. With 24 consecutive months: additive Holt-Winters; with 6–23 months: constant mean. History length does not establish reliability.
strForecast.csvHint: One row per consecutive month. Comma, semicolon or tab delimiter; decimal commas require semicolons. Occupancy: 0.72, 72 or 72%; 1% means 0.01. Optional nights: blank = estimate, 0 = zero nights. Optional exact header: date,occupancy,adr,nights (or omit nights). Atomic import; at least 6 months to calculate.
strForecast.noRows: No valid rows detected in CSV.
strForecast.emptyState: Load your 6+ months of history (CSV or demo) to generate the forecast.
strForecast.insufficientData: {count} months imported: at least 6 consecutive months are needed to calculate, without an accuracy guarantee.
strForecast.methodology: Method: additive Holt-Winters with fixed α=0.3, β=0.1, γ=0.3 and a 12-month period from 24 observations. Below that: observation mean, no trend or seasonality. Forecast occupancy is bounded to 0–100% and ADR to zero minimum. The range only applies the selected revenue variation; it is not a confidence interval. No independent backtest is shown. Inputs are retained only during this page session.
strForecast.revenueScope: Historical revenue uses reported sold nights × ADR; without nights, it is estimated as occupancy × actual calendar days × ADR. Zero nights remain zero. Forecast revenue uses occupancy × calendar days × ADR. These are gross accommodation receipts before costs, commissions and taxes. Do not combine multiple units or partial availability in this model.
strForecast.demoNotice: Entirely fictional example, with no market data. Results and CSV are marked as a demonstration.
strForecast.invalidImport: Invalid CSV: YYYY-MM dates, unique consecutive months, occupancy 0–100%, non-negative ADR and whole sold nights between zero and the days in the month. No rows were imported.

energyAudit.recToitureDesc: Priority #1 — roof accounts for 25-30 % of thermal losses in an uninsulated building. Mineral wool blowing or PU panels.
energyAudit.recFacadeDesc: External thermal insulation — 20-30 % losses, eliminates thermal bridges. Building permit may be needed.
energyAudit.recFenetresDesc: Triple glazing Uw ≤ 0.9 W/m²K. Strong visual impact, immediate comfort and value gain.
energyAudit.recSolDesc: Below (accessible basement) or above (during full renovation). 5-10 % savings.
energyAudit.recChauffageDesc: Air-source or geothermal HP — eligible 70 % Klimabonus if COP ≥ 3.5. Removes fuel oil (new ban 2026).
energyAudit.recVMCDesc: Mechanical ventilation with heat recovery — > 85 % efficiency, eliminates humidity/mold. Mandatory post-ETICS.
energyAudit.recECSDesc: HPWH — 60-70 % savings vs electric. Can be coupled with heating HP.
energyAudit.recPVDesc: Self-consumption + surplus export. Payback 8-12 yrs. 6 kWp = 6,000-9,000 kWh/yr in Luxembourg.

marcheForecast.title: Property price scenarios
marcheForecast.subtitle: Calculate how your annual growth assumptions affect a starting price. No local historical prices or probabilities are estimated.
marcheForecast.reference: Mean recorded price of existing apartments
marcheForecast.copy: Use this mean as a starting assumption
marcheForecast.referenceScope: This mean covers the stated period and multiple properties. It is neither a current valuation of a specific property nor its value in the selected starting month. Changing municipality clears the entered price.
marcheForecast.ratesScope: The initial 0% rates are neutral, with no implied forecast. Enter assumptions in ascending order: low ≤ middle ≤ high.
marcheForecast.invalid: Enter a strictly positive price (maximum €1,000,000/m²), a month from 2000 to 2099 and three ordered rates above −100% and no higher than 100%. An empty field is not zero.
marcheForecast.chartTitle: Calculated prices at the selected horizon
marcheForecast.anchor: Declared starting point, not a historical observation.
marcheForecast.formula: Price in month h = starting price × (1 + annual rate / 100)^(h / 12). Calculations retain full precision; displayed values are rounded to two decimals.
marcheForecast.methodScope: Rates are constant and compounded. Results are nominal euros per m², excluding fees, works and taxes. They are not an appraisal, a statistical forecast or a confidence interval. No local history is reconstructed from national data.

particulier.title: Individual guide
particulier.intro: Whether buying your home, valuing an inherited property, or simulating a first rental investment, tevaxia covers your path from A to Z with tools calibrated on the Luxembourg market.
particulier.parcoursIntro: Three steps a Luxembourg individual typically takes before signing.
particulier.parcoursStep1Desc: Enter address, area and energy class on /estimation. Indicative low/central/high value in 30s. For atypical or historical property, use /valorisation EVS 2025.
particulier.parcoursStep2Desc: /frais-acquisition gives notary + registration + Bëllegen Akt + VAT. Cross with /simulateur-aides for Klimabonus, commune aids, renovation.
particulier.parcoursStep3Desc: /achat-vs-location runs 1000 Monte-Carlo scenarios. You see the probability that buying wins based on holding period, alternative yield, and appreciation.
particulier.toolsIntro: Click to jump directly to each.
particulier.faq1q: Do I need to log in to use the tools?
particulier.faq1a: No, most public tools (estimation, fees, aids, capital gains) work without an account. An account lets you save estimates to the cloud (500 free items), receive price alerts per commune and generate signed PDF reports.
particulier.faq2q: Is the tevaxia estimate accepted by banks?
particulier.faq2a: These percentages are working assumptions, not official Observatory coefficients. No MAPE, R², significance or accuracy on real sales has been demonstrated.
particulier.faq3q: How does the Bëllegen Akt work?
particulier.faq3a: The Bëllegen Abatement (law 09/07/2014, amended) offers a registration duty tax credit of up to €30,000 per buyer for a primary residence. /frais-acquisition computes it automatically based on your profile (resident, first-time, couple/single).
particulier.faq4q: Can I use tevaxia for property in France or Belgium?
particulier.faq4a: The methods (hedonic estimation, DCF, fees) are international, but LU-specific tools (Bëllegen Akt, Klimabonus, PAG, AIS) don't apply. For a cross-border property, use /estimation in generic mode + adjust fees per local legislation.
particulier.ctaDesc: Create a free account to save estimates, receive alerts and generate PDF reports.

expert.title: Expert / valuer guide
expert.intro: TEGOVA REV/TRV, notary, tax advisor, court expert: tevaxia gives you EVS 2025 valuation tools, a public calibrated hedonic model, and a SHA-256 signable report verifiable by your client.
expert.parcoursIntro: From mission request to signed report delivery.
expert.parcoursStep1Desc: Enter the property in /valorisation (3 templates: standard, bank MLV, judicial/estate). Auto-loads comparables via ACT + Housing Observatory.
expert.parcoursStep2Desc: Compare hedonic value (/hedonique CI 95%) + multi-tenant DCF (/dcf-multi) + ACT comparables. The module reconciles the 3 methods with configurable weighting.
expert.parcoursStep3Desc: PDF EVS 2025 export with SHA-256 block + /verify URL. Client can publicly verify report integrity without API. Immutable in DB (law 12.02.1979 art. 61-63).
expert.faq1a: These percentages are working assumptions, not official Observatory coefficients. No MAPE, R², significance or accuracy on real sales has been demonstrated.
expert.faq2a: On issuance, the PDF is hashed and the hash stored in DB (immutable via trigger). The signature block contains hash + /verify URL + timestamp. Client pastes URL on /verify which re-hashes and compares — if matches, integrity guaranteed. No costly PKI needed.
expert.faq3a: /profil/organisation lets you create a firm, invite members (admin/member/viewer roles), share valuations. Admin stats via OrgAgencyStats: top valuers, API calls, conversion. VIES lookup on creation to pre-fill from VAT number.
expert.faq4q: Can I export to DOCX for my firm template?
expert.faq4a: The tevaxia PDF is the signable deliverable. For an editable DOCX, use 'Copy JSON' and import into your Word template via mail-merge, or contact us for custom templated DOCX export.
expert.ctaDesc: Pro account + B2B organisation for valuers: 10,000 reports cap, multi-user, agency stats.

syndic.title: Syndic / condominium guide
syndic.intro: Professional or volunteer syndic: tevaxia covers Luxembourg condominiums (law 16.05.1975 amended, bill 7763 works fund) from unit register to owner portal via GMs and accounting.
syndic.parcoursIntro: Yearly cycle, from closing to GM.
syndic.parcoursStep1Desc: /syndic/coproprietes: create a condo, enter units (area, shares, EPC class), owners (owner-occupier vs landlord). Auto charge split by shares.
syndic.parcoursStep2Desc: Generate quarterly funds calls + works fund (bill 7763: min 5% capitalisation if building > 10 years old). Accounting 11th ed. LU chart of accounts, bank exports for transfers.
syndic.parcoursStep3Desc: PDF convocation law 16.05.1975 art. 7, agenda, proxy. Signable minutes, video conference supported. 10-year archives in encrypted bucket SHA-256 + DB immutability (art. 13bis).
syndic.faq1q: Is bill 7763 on works fund integrated?
syndic.faq1a: Yes. /syndic/coproprietes/[id]/fonds-travaux computes minimum legal capitalisation (5% of annual operating budget for buildings > 10 years), multi-year works plan (PPT), and alert thresholds. When the law is enacted (expected 2026-2027), tools will switch to final parameters.
syndic.faq2q: What's the difference between LU and FR syndic?
syndic.faq2a: In LU, syndic is not mandatory if < 5 units and unanimous representation. No mandatory separate account (unlike FR ALUR law). No official ARC/ASCR. Fees are free (competition Matera/Cotoit online vs traditional firms). tevaxia tools are LU-calibrated but 11th PCMN accounting methods are standard BE/LU.
syndic.faq3q: How to send GM convocation and collect proxies?
syndic.faq3a: /syndic/procuration generates a PDF compliant with art. 7 + art. 11 law 16.05.1975 (agent, powers, time limit). Email via Resend/SendGrid (your key). The owner portal also allows co-owners to grant proxy online with Supabase auth.
syndic.faq4q: How much does tevaxia cost for a syndic?
syndic.faq4a: Free plan: 500 cloud items = fits 1-3 condos. Pro plan (SARL-S LU incorporation in progress) = 10,000 items, multi-user org_type syndic, distinct 'conseil_syndical' / 'coproprietaire' roles. Early adopter lifetime pricing for first registrants.
syndic.ctaDesc: Free up to 500 cloud items. Create an account and CSV-import units in 5 min.

hotelier.title: Hotelier guide
hotelier.intro: The PMS area contains property and reservation management screens. Analysis tools use their own inputs and sources; no automatic transfer to the group is assumed.
hotelier.parcoursIntro: From a new hotel project to daily operations.
hotelier.parcoursStep1Desc: Document price, cash flows, costs, funding and comparison sources. The due diligence file gathers your evidence and observations; it is not legal or technical approval.
hotelier.parcoursStep2Desc: Enter rooms and property settings. Check rates, tax treatment and any local taxes before use; no setup duration is guaranteed.
hotelier.parcoursStep3Desc: Check reservations, charges, rates and supporting documents before producing an invoice or report. Stored data alone does not establish tax or accounting validity.
hotelier.faq1q: Does the PMS handle multiple hotels?
hotelier.faq1a: Group files contain user-entered periods. They do not automatically consolidate PMS reservations or KPIs. Compare identical periods in the benchmark.
hotelier.faq2q: Can I sync with Booking and Airbnb?
hotelier.faq2a: Check the import/export functions offered for your property and how the destination channel works. An iCal calendar guarantees neither immediate updates nor freedom from overbooking; check rates and payments separately.
hotelier.faq3a: The rate depends on the service and VAT Act schedules. F&B does not determine one universal rate. Check each line and any local tax against applicable sources.
hotelier.faq4a: GOP = departmental profit − general expenses. EBITDA = GOP − management fees + non-operating income − non-operating expenses. The reserve is deducted afterwards. This simplified statement is not USALI certification, a benchmark or net profit after financing and income tax.
hotelier.faq5q: How to get Green Key ESG certification?
hotelier.faq5a: The Green Key file references criteria and evidence for the selected version. It does not calculate eligibility or issue certification. Confirm the procedure with Green Key.
hotelier.ctaDesc: Open your account and enter property data. Check offer terms for features and access limits.

investisseur.title: Investor guide
investisseur.intro: Individual or institutional investor: tevaxia equips you for DCF analysis, multi-asset portfolio tracking, acquisition vs energy retrofit arbitrage, and LU annex 190 tax export.
investisseur.parcoursIntro: From identified opportunity to post-acquisition tracking.
investisseur.parcoursStep1Desc: /dcf-multi analyses declared rental cash flows. /bilan-promoteur calculates projected profit or residual land budget from documented revenue and costs.
investisseur.parcoursStep2Desc: /outils-bancaires: credit simulation with ECB/OAT/mortgage 8y rates, early repayment (LU max 6-month indemnity), 3-offer TCC comparator.
investisseur.parcoursStep3Desc: /portfolio: multi-asset with LTV, net yield, 12-month rolling cashflow, annex 190 tax export (interest, PNO, tax, management, depreciation). 180-day bin before permanent deletion (GDPR).
investisseur.faq1q: Does DCF support complex multi-tenant leases?
investisseur.faq1a: Yes, /dcf-multi handles N leases per asset with distinct dates, CPI indexation, rent-free, step rents, tenant/landlord break options, reversion. Monthly lease-by-lease view year 1, cap rate × discount rate 5×5 sensitivity. CSV portfolio import + downloadable template.
investisseur.faq2q: How to integrate energy impact in my analysis?
investisseur.faq2a: /energy/portfolio aggregates your assets' EPCs, computes CRREM stranding risk (what share of portfolio will be 'stranded' by EPBD 2030/2033/2050 deadlines) and prioritises retrofits by ROI. Crosses with Klimabonus aids.
investisseur.faq3q: Can I share an analysis with my bank or firm?
investisseur.faq3a: /profil/liens-partages: generates a read-only public link (secure token, configurable expiry, optional max_views, rate-limited anonymous comments). Your counterpart views without account. View analytics + 30d sparkline owner-side.
investisseur.faq4q: What's LU capital gains tax policy for an investor?
investisseur.faq4a: /plus-values computes taxation per art. 99bis-101 LIR. Rate = half of global rate for > 2 years holding (art. 100 LIR), €50,000 allowance every 10 years (art. 102 LIR). Full exemption for primary residence (art. 100 para. 3). Reinvestment tax deferral art. 102 LIR. SCI/SARL share transfers (art. 100 LIR): 23% half-rate if ≥ 10% + > 6 months.
investisseur.ctaDesc: Pro: 10,000 cloud items, advanced exports, multi-user org_type investor.

agence.title: Real estate agency guide
agence.intro: LU/BE agency, property manager: co-branded estimate report in 1 PDF, pro-agences CRM (contacts, interactions, tasks, documents), mandate pipeline, Athome/atHome Pro/Immotop portal-compat export.
agence.parcoursIntro: From prospect to signed mandate to closed sale.
agence.parcoursStep1Desc: /pro-agences/fiche-bien: A4 PDF with agency logo, agent contact, custom legal footer. Estimate + acquisition costs + aids per prospect profile. Turns a 1st meeting into a mandate.
agence.parcoursStep2Desc: /pro-agences/crm: contacts (prospect/lead/buyer/seller) + mandate Kanban (prospect → signed → compromise → sold) + interaction timeline (calls/emails/visits) + tasks with reminders. CSV Athome / atHome Pro / Immotop export.
agence.parcoursStep3Desc: Estimated/received commissions tracked per mandate. 30-day expiry alerts. 5-year KYC archiving (law 12.11.2004) with encrypted SHA-256 bucket. Multi-agent roles via /profil/organisation.
agence.toolsIntro: From prospecting to full commercial tracking.
agence.faq1q: Is the co-branded report compliant with LU agent law?
agence.faq1a: Yes. PDF includes agency logo + professional real estate licence number (law 28.12.1988), legal mention 'non-contractual document, indicative value'. For a mandate, /pro-agences/mandats generates clauses compliant with grand-ducal regulation 04.07.2000 (min 3-month exclusive mandate, compensation, obligations).
agence.faq2q: Can I invite multiple agents to my agency?
agence.faq2a: Yes via /profil/organisation. Roles: admin (everything), member (agent, sees own + agency mandates read-only), viewer (read-only). Top 5 agents stats, API calls per member, mandate → sale conversion. VIES lookup to pre-fill agency VAT.
agence.faq3a: /pro-agences/mandats has CSV export compat Athome Pro (official format: address, area, price, photo URLs). Bidirectional import unsupported (no public API). If you have Athome Pro account, export from tevaxia then import in a few clicks.
agence.faq4q: Is AML/KYC mandatory for an agency?
agence.faq4a: Yes. Amended law 12.11.2004 on AML-CFT makes agents subject since 2019. /aml-kyc/archives stores KYC documents (ID, income proof, UBO) in encrypted SHA-256 bucket with 5-year retention post-business relationship, integrated EU/OFAC/UN/CSSF sanctions screening.
agence.ctaDesc: Free demo, 30-day trial, no commitment. Preferential early-adopter pricing.

promoteur.title: Developer guide
promoteur.intro: Developer, builder, property dealer: operation P&L, tornado sensitivity, multi-tranche phasing, VEFA intrinsic/extrinsic GFA, CCAP/CCTP templates compliant law 08/04/2018.
promoteur.parcoursIntro: From land to delivery, with execution tracking.
promoteur.parcoursStep1Desc: /pag-pap: PAG zones, buildability (COS/CMU × zone), road setback + green space. Public geoportail.lu geocoder. /convertisseur-surfaces to go from cadastral → buildable.
promoteur.parcoursStep2Desc: Documented revenue and costs, pre-tax profit, target profit and residual land budget. Declared monthly schedule and reloadable JSON dossier.
promoteur.parcoursStep3Desc: /vefa: staggered funds calls, construction delay (0-24 month slider) and intercalary interest surcharge, intrinsic vs extrinsic GFA (insurer, 0.3-2% premium). /estimateur-construction : Build a budget from your quotes and identified assumptions. Enter all prices including VAT in euros. No tariff, professional fee or energy premium is assumed.
promoteur.faq1q: Does operation P&L include 3% new-build VAT?
promoteur.faq1a: Use a consistent tax basis throughout: exclude only VAT that is actually recoverable and include non-recoverable VAT. Tax rates, duties, refunds and income taxes are not calculated automatically.
promoteur.faq2q: How does intrinsic vs extrinsic GFA work?
promoteur.faq2a: /vefa separates both: extrinsic (insurer or bank guarantees if developer defaults, 0.3-2% of revenue premium) vs intrinsic (developer equity deposited with notary). Extrinsic is mandatory to sell VEFA in LU (law 28.12.1976 art. 2-11). Tool computes both costs for arbitration.
promoteur.faq3a: Build a budget from your quotes and identified assumptions. Enter all prices including VAT in euros. No tariff, professional fee or energy premium is assumed. The STATEC index measures price changes in residential construction, excluding VAT and land. It is not a quote or a universal price per m². No unit cost on this page is attributed to STATEC or Batiprix.
promoteur.faq4q: Can I share the P&L with my banker?
promoteur.faq4a: Yes, /profil/liens-partages generates a read-only public link with secure token. Banker sees P&L without tevaxia account. Print/PDF button on viewer side. Analytics: you see view count and last consultation.
promoteur.ctaDesc: CSV import of actual costs, month-by-month execution tracking, margin overrun alert.

api.title: API integrator guide
api.intro: PropTech, bank, fintech: integrate MLV valuation, hedonic estimation and LU fees into your workflows via public REST API. OpenAPI 3.1, self-managed keys, transparent quotas, HMAC-signed webhooks.
api.parcoursStep1Desc: /profil/api: create a key with scope (estimation, mlv, dcf, fees), monthly quota, IP allowlist. Manual rotation, instant revocation. Full logs (call, latency, error) visible in real-time.
api.parcoursStep2Desc: /api-docs: OpenAPI 3.1 with Try-it-out, cURL examples, request/response schemas. Available endpoints: POST /api/v1/estimation, /api/v1/mlv, /api/v1/propcalc/{yield,cashflow,mortgage,fees}, /api/v1/ai/analyze, batch /api/v1/estimation/batch.
api.parcoursStep3Desc: Configure a webhook to receive events (estimation complete, report signed) with HMAC-SHA256 signature in X-Tevaxia-Signature. Test endpoint: /api/v1/webhooks/test.
api.faq1q: What are the quotas and pricing?
api.faq1a: Free tier: 100 requests/day (dev/test usage). Pro tier (LU SARL-S incorporation ongoing): 10,000 requests/month, 100 req/min rate limit. Enterprise: custom quotas, 99.9% SLA, dedicated support. No per-request billing (flat-rate pricing).
api.faq2q: Is there a TypeScript / Python SDK?
api.faq2a: No official SDK yet. API is standard REST (JSON, Bearer auth) usable with any HTTP client: fetch, axios, requests, httpx. SDK will be published if call volume > 1M/month. OpenAPI schemas importable in Postman / Insomnia.
api.faq3a: PDF reports (EVS valuation) include SHA-256 signature verifiable at /verify. JSON responses aren't signed by default (client already authenticates with API key). On Enterprise request: JWT response signature possible.
api.faq4a: These percentages are working assumptions, not official Observatory coefficients. No MAPE, R², significance or accuracy on real sales has been demonstrated.
api.ctaDesc: Free API key in 2 min, OpenAPI documentation + playground, support via Intercom.

str_operator.title: Short-term rental guide
str_operator.intro: Airbnb, Booking, STR concierge operator: LU profitability calculators, EU 2024/1028 regulation compliance, 3-month/year LU licensing threshold, long vs short-term arbitrage.
str_operator.parcoursIntro: From analysing an STR property to EU 2024/1028 compliance.
str_operator.parcoursStep1Desc: /str/forecast: 12-month forecast (nights rented × ADR × occupancy rate), LU seasonality (low winter / August Schueberfouer / MICE Sept-June). Occupancy ±10pp sensitivity. LU Hotel Observatory benchmarks.
str_operator.parcoursStep2Desc: /str: compares STR yield (Airbnb) vs classical lease with net charges (concierge ~20%, cleaning fees, furniture depreciation, vacancy). For Luxembourg-City: break-even occupancy often > 55% to beat a €1200/month lease.
str_operator.parcoursStep3Desc: /str/compliance: EU unified Airbnb/Booking registry (in force mid-2026, mandatory commune data transmission). In LU: 3-month/year threshold beyond which lodging licence required. Exportable PDF dossier for tax authority.
str_operator.faq1a: Mandatory registration in a unified European register (member state-issued registration number), automatic transmission of rental data to authorities (nights, amount), visible registration number on Airbnb/Booking. Progressive entry into force mid-2026. /str/compliance tracks LU transposition.
str_operator.faq2q: Must I declare STR income to IRL?
str_operator.faq2a: Yes, as BIC income (accessory commercial activity if < €23k/year gross, professional above). VAT: franchise < €35k/year. Commune tourist tax: due from 1 night. For non-resident expats, LU-France/BE/DE tax treaty with anti-abuse provision. /plus-values handles sale of an STR property per art. 102bis LIR.
str_operator.faq3a: Beyond 90 cumulative days/year of short-term rental of a non-primary-residence property in Luxembourg-City, commercial lodging licence required (law 03.11.1998 + commune regulation). Chamber of commerce registration, ICC + IRC + 3% lodging VAT + tourist tax + commune GM. /str/compliance alerts at 80% of threshold.
str_operator.faq4q: Dynamic pricing like PriceLabs / Wheelhouse integrated?
str_operator.faq4a: Not yet. /str/forecast does static seasonal forecast. For real-time dynamic pricing with market competition, third-party solutions PriceLabs ($19.99/listing), Wheelhouse, Beyond Pricing. Our roadmap includes a 'smart pricing' module based on STATEC Observatory + STR EMEA for 2027.
str_operator.ctaDesc: Free 12-month forecast + EU 2024/1028 compliance + LU benchmark.

q2.q: How do I use tevaxia with a dematerialisation platform?
q2.a: Create the invoice in tevaxia (form + business template), download the Factur-X file (PDF/A-3 with embedded XML), then import it into your dematerialisation platform. All DGFiP-accredited PDPs accept the standard Factur-X format.

q3.q: Can I use tevaxia to comply by 01/09/2026?
q3.a: tevaxia generates EN 16931-compliant Factur-X. For full compliance with the French reform, a reception solution (accredited PDP or PPF) is also required. Our tool covers the issuance side; mandatory reception from 01/09/2026 is handled separately.

q4.q: Is Luxembourg affected by the French reform?
q4.a: No, the 01/09/2026 reform only applies to French VAT-registered entities. Luxembourg has its own e-invoicing schedule via Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (mandatory B2G, B2B in progress). tevaxia supports both standards.

q5.q: Why use a file rather than a direct API?
q5.a: Dematerialisation platform APIs change regularly and dedicated integrations require continuous maintenance. A standard compliant file can be imported manually or via your platform's own API depending on your preference, without dependency on a technical partnership.

q6.q: Is the data stored in the EU?
q6.a: Invoices are generated locally in the browser and downloaded directly. For signed-in users, the 12-month history is stored on Supabase (AWS eu-central-1, Frankfurt). See the Privacy Policy.

International franchises (Marriott, Hilton, Accor) often impose a contractual minimum (PIP, Product Improvement Plan). For an independent hotel, budget annually in the operating cash flow (otherwise quick drift vs chains).

glRelances.pageSubtitle: 3 configured levels: friendly reminder D+15 → formal demand D+30 → payment order D+60. PDF compliant with law 21.09.2006, to be sent by registered mail (paper or eIDAS).
glRelances.pdfClosing: Please accept, Madam, Sir, the expression of our best regards.
glRelances.pdfFooter: Document generated by tevaxia.lu · Compliant with the Luxembourg residential lease law of 21 September 2006 · {mode}
glRelances.pdfModeRegistered: Registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt
glRelances.pdfLevel1Body: We are sending you this friendly reminder to inform you that an amount of {amount} € remains unpaid for the rent of period {period}. We thank you for settling the situation as soon as possible. We remain at your disposal for any information.
glRelances.pdfLevel2Body: By way of this formal demand, we require you to pay the sum of {amount} € corresponding to the rent of period {period}, unpaid for more than 30 days. Failing payment within 15 days from receipt of this letter, we reserve the right to seize the competent court.
glRelances.pdfLevel3Body: Payment order: failing payment within 8 days, we will seize the competent court to obtain your conviction to pay the sum of {amount} € (rent {period}), increased by legal interest, procedure costs and, where applicable, lease termination. You also have time to contact the municipality's Social Service if you are facing difficulties.
glRelances.legalBody: after 60 days of non-payment, you can seize the Justice of the Peace to obtain a conditional payment order (art. 12 law 21.09.2006), then engage lease termination proceedings if no regularisation. The payment order can be issued by a bailiff (300-500€). An eIDAS-certified version is planned via Yousign/LuxTrust partnership.

glColoc.draftNote: Entered shares are drafts until saved individually. Preparation splits the remainder between active cotenants at 0%, preserving positive active shares. Amounts use saved shares only when they total 100%. Residual cents are allocated to preserve the total.

hotelMice.pageSubtitle: Group/seminar revenue model for a hotel with meeting rooms. Covers rooms + F&B + room rental. RFP conversion rate, average basket, seasonality.
hotelMice.inputFbCaptureHint: % of groups consuming F&B on site
hotelMice.seasonSubtitle: Typical distribution of corporate groups in Luxembourg: peaks Sep-Nov + Mar-May, troughs summer + holidays.
hotelMice.seasonSource: Source: patterns observed in Luxembourg City (HOTREC Luxembourg, Hotrec EU MICE trends 2024-2025). Gold line = annual average. The Jul-Aug trough can be filled by leisure groups (weddings, family) or international MICE (incentive travel).
hotelMice.seasonJan: Low, new year + budgets not approved

esgCrrem.pageSubtitle: Assessment of the stranding risk of a property under the CRREM 1.5 °C pathway. LU calibration (electric grid 79 gCO₂/kWh, gas 201 gCO₂/kWh). Supports the 8 CRREM 2024 asset classes. SFDR Art. 8/9 and PAI 2 reporting compliant.
esgCrrem.consumptionNote: kWh per source (NCV). Current total: {total} kWh
esgCrrem.gapTitle: Gap to close vs CRREM 1.5 °C pathway
esgCrrem.disclaimer: Indicative analysis. For official SFDR reporting, consult your Risk Officer + accredited ESG auditor. CRREM v3.0 (2024) trajectories are EU-average 1.5 °C Paris-aligned pathways. For a specific LU asset, the carbon trajectory may be more permissive thanks to the 79 gCO₂/kWh grid vs EU 244.

syndicProc.pageSubtitle: Generate a proxy for representation at a condominium AGM compliant with the Luxembourg law of 16 May 1975 (articles 7 and 11). To be handed signed to the designated proxy.
syndicProc.alertMissing: Please fill in the mandatory fields (*).
syndicProc.inputMandataireNameHint: The person who will represent you at the AGM
syndicProc.inputPlaceHint: e.g. Syndic office, 5 rue X, L-2000 Luxembourg
syndicProc.warningBody: check with your condominium rules the maximum number of shares a proxy can represent (often 5%). The syndic itself generally cannot act as proxy unless expressly authorised. The proxy must be signed and dated before the meeting. The handwritten mention "bon pour pouvoir" is recommended.
syndicProc.legalBody: amended law of 16 May 1975 on condominiums, articles 7 (general meeting) and 11 (representation). The template generated here is indicative and compliant with practices. For special cases (syndic proxy, blank power of attorney, minor/protected co-owner), consult your syndic or notary.

syndicPortefeuille.pageSubtitle: Consolidated view of managed condominiums. Prioritised by decreasing arrears to target recovery actions.
syndicPortefeuille.routineBody: Monday morning view to plan the week. Condominiums sorted by decreasing arrears to prioritise recovery. Planned AGMs flag preparations (convocation, agenda, annexes) to be anticipated 15 days ahead.

esgTaxo.pageSubtitle: Real estate asset qualification under Regulation (EU) 2020/852 (Taxonomy) and Climate Delegated Act 2021/2139. For bank CRR Pillar 3 ESG due diligence and SFDR Art. 8/9 funds. LU calibration (nZEB thresholds grand-ducal regulation 23.07.2016, top 15% PED indicative Klima-Agence 2023).
esgTaxo.addressPlaceholder: e.g. 12 rue de la Gare, Luxembourg City
esgTaxo.step2Intro: Activity 7.7 "Acquisition and ownership of buildings". Options: (1) post-2020 building with PED ≤ nZEB − 10%, (2) older building in the top 15% PED local, or (3) older building with EPC class A or B.
esgTaxo.buildBeforeEpcA: Older, EPC class A or B
esgTaxo.buildBeforeOther: Older, neither A/B nor top 15% documented
esgTaxo.step3Title: 3. DNSH, Do No Significant Harm (6 criteria)
esgTaxo.step3Intro: The property must not significantly harm the other 5 EU environmental objectives. Each axis must be documented / certified.
esgTaxo.dnshClimateHint: Vulnerability study over 10/30-year horizons: flood, heatwave, wind, etc.
esgTaxo.dnshAdaptHint: Identified and scheduled adaptation measures (passive cooling, drainage, etc.)
esgTaxo.dnshWaterHint: Taps ≤ 6 L/min, showers ≤ 8 L/min, dual-flush WC (Decision (EU) 2017/1381)
esgTaxo.dnshCircularLabel: Circular Economy, 70% of C&D waste recycled
esgTaxo.dnshCircularHint: At least 70% of construction and demolition waste (excluding soil and rocks) reused / recycled
esgTaxo.dnshPollutionHint: Absence of SVHC substances > 0.1% by weight (REACH annex XVII). Compliant paints / adhesives / composite wood.
esgTaxo.dnshBiodivHint: Property outside Natura 2000, listed sites and FAO I-III arable land. Ecological impact assessment if > 1000 sqm.
esgTaxo.step4Intro: 4 international pillars. In practice for an appraiser / small investor: self-declaration. For a fund or bank: formal policy + annual due diligence.
esgTaxo.msUngpLabel: UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
esgTaxo.msUngpHint: Value-chain human rights due diligence (owner, tenants, providers)
esgTaxo.msIloHint: 8 fundamental ILO conventions: freedom of association, abolition of forced & child labour, non-discrimination
esgTaxo.msHrHint: UDHR + ICCPR + ICESCR, fundamental rights in property operation
esgTaxo.alignedDescYes: The property meets the 3 pillars (SC + DNSH + Minimum Safeguards)
esgTaxo.alignedDescNo: At least one pillar fails, see recommendations
esgTaxo.usageBody: attach this screening to the bank due-diligence file (CRR Pillar 3 ESG) or to the SFDR Art. 8/9 reporting of LU real estate funds. For official publication, the Taxonomy declaration must be verified by an accredited auditor and signed by the manager or board.

syndicLettres.pageSubtitle: {official} official templates + {custom} custom. Editable, exportable to DOCX / PDF / Google Drive.
syndicLettres.previewEmpty: Select a template on the left.
syndicLettres.usageBody: editing official templates creates a custom copy (originals remain intact). Custom templates are stored locally in your browser (localStorage) and never leave your device.
syndicLettres.flashDrive: DOCX downloaded + Google Drive opened. Drag and drop the file.
syndicLettres.officialWarn: ⚠ Official template: a custom copy will be created, the original remains intact.
syndicLettres.importOption1Body: Upload .docx (Word), .txt or .md: the 1st line becomes the subject, the rest the body. Complex Word formatting (tables, images) is not preserved, only plain text is extracted.

syndicVisio.pageSubtitle: General meeting via videoconference (Jitsi Meet, free, encrypted, no account required). Weighted electronic voting is handled via
syndicVisio.readyTitle: Ready to start the AGM via videoconference?
syndicVisio.jitsiNote: Jitsi Meet service (meet.jit.si), free and end-to-end encrypted. Share this page link with the co-owners, no Jitsi account needed.
syndicVisio.legalBody: AGM by videoconference has been allowed since the Grand-Ducal regulation of 20 June 2020. Conditions: (1) convocation explicitly mentioning the videoconference format; (2) participant identification; (3) real-time interaction; (4) ability to vote; (5) minutes listing videoconference participants. Weighted voting by shares is handled in the Meetings tab.

syndicMessagerie.pageSubtitle: Real-time communications with co-owners. Public announcements, private threads, incidents.
syndicMessagerie.selectThread: Select a conversation or create one.
syndicMessagerie.realtimeBody: messages appear instantly via Supabase Realtime (WebSocket). Co-owners can reply from their portal

syndicSepa.pageSubtitle: Generate a pain.001.001.09 XML file (SEPA Credit Transfer) that can be imported into your LU web banking (BCEE, BIL, BGL, Spuerkeess, Raiffeisen, ING) to execute N supplier transfers in a batch with a single validation.
syndicSepa.usageBody: download the XML, import it into your web banking (BCEE: Transfers → Import SEPA files · BIL: Import SCT · Spuerkeess: SEPA Bulk Upload) then validate with your LuxTrust / Token. Banks apply the transfers on the requested execution date if funds are available. ISO 20022 pain.001.001.09 format accepted by all SEPA banks (EU + EEA).

syndicArchives.pageSubtitle: Retention compliant with the law of 16 May 1975 (art. 13bis): AGM minutes, invoices, contracts, closed accounts. Files encrypted at rest (AES-256), immutable, SHA-256 checksum.
syndicArchives.immutableWarn: ⚠ Once archived, the document is immutable and cannot be deleted for 10 years (law 16.05.1975 art. 13bis). Check before archiving.
syndicArchives.legalBody: archives are kept for 10 years in accordance with the amended law of 16 May 1975 on condominiums (art. 13bis). Each file has a SHA-256 checksum to guarantee integrity. Files are encrypted at rest (AES-256). The table is immutable at the DB level (trigger 'archive_is_immutable'), no modification or deletion is possible before expiry.

syndicOcr.pageSubtitlePrefix: Automatic extraction of the key information on an invoice (amount, VAT, IBAN, invoice no., date, due date) via
syndicOcr.pageSubtitleSuffix: (scanned invoices). 100% free, 100% client-side, no data sent to any external service.
syndicOcr.formatError: Unsupported format. Use PDF or image (JPG/PNG).
syndicOcr.uploadHint: Digital PDF (preferred, instant) or scanned PDF / image (Tesseract OCR, slower).
syndicOcr.uploadFormats: Formats: PDF · JPG · PNG · Limit 20 MB
syndicOcr.stageOcr: Tesseract OCR running (30s-2min depending on size)…
syndicOcr.tesseractNote: 💡 Tesseract.js downloads ~20MB of OCR data the 1st time (cached after).
syndicOcr.lowConfidence: ⚠️ Low confidence. Manually check every value before posting in accounting.

syndicOcr.howItem4: Heuristic parser identifies amounts / VAT / IBAN / dates using LU/EU regexes.
syndicOcr.howItem5: 100% client-side, no data sent to any external service.

syndicFondsTravaux.pageSubtitle: Capital reserve for major future works, anticipating draft law 7763 (modernisation of the 16 May 1975 act).

syndicFondsTravaux.emptyMovements: No movements yet. Start by logging the annual contribution voted at the AGM.
syndicFondsTravaux.regulatoryBody: Draft law 7763 (modernisation of the 16 May 1975 act) will make a works fund mandatory for all LU condominiums with a minimum annual contribution. This page anticipates the coming into force. Update the parameters once published in Mémorial A.

syndicTravaux.emptyProjects: No projects. Create one with the button above.
syndicTravaux.noActiveProject: Select a project or create one to see quotes and invoices.

syndicBudget.confirmClone: Clone budget from {y} to {y2} with +2% indexation?
syndicBudget.accountsNotInit: The chart of accounts is not yet initialised.
syndicBudget.natureInfoBody: ordinary (voted annual budget), works (off-budget, specific vote), works fund (provision law of 10 June 1999, mandatory > 10 units in LU), exceptional (loss, litigation). The classification drives allocation across calls for funds and AGM accounting annexes.

syndicCles.pageSubtitle: Define expense-specific allocation rules: heating prorated by heated area, lift excluded on ground floor, separate stair A/B, etc. Follows LU condominium practice (16 May 1975 act + bylaw).

syndicCles.usageBody2: , assign this key to an account (e.g. 606 Energy → heating key). When generating a call for funds, allocation will automatically use the shares defined here instead of general shares.

syndicAnnexes.pageSubtitle: The 5 mandatory annexes to be handed to co-owners 15 days before the annual AGM. Follows LU condominium practice (16 May 1975 + 10 June 1999 acts).
syndicAnnexes.emptyTravaux: No works expense for the year.
syndicAnnexes.allUpToDate: ✓ All co-owners are up to date.
syndicAnnexes.moreLinesInPdf: … {n} additional line(s) in the full PDF.

syndicRelances.pageSubtitle: 3-tier engine (D+15 amicable → D+30 formal notice → D+60 final notice) with LU statutory interest (5.75%) and immutable audit trail for litigation use.
