dcfLeaseAudit.csvInvalid: CSV rejected: check template headers, columns, dates and numbers. Existing rows have not been replaced.
dcfLeaseAudit.invalid: Complete at least one lease and all parameters. YYYY-MM dates in 1900–2199, end at or after start, early exit within the lease; positive area, non-negative amounts, probabilities and rates from 0 to 100% (exit rate > 0), indexation −100 to 100%, whole horizon 1–50 years. Recurring terminal cash flow must be positive.
dcfLeaseAudit.wault: Area-weighted remaining term of active leases
dcfLeaseAudit.exportScope: The lease CSV includes lease inputs and rent steps. The monthly CSV contains lease-level flows; global fixed expenses and CAPEX reserve are in the annual table and PDF. The PDF records assumptions and amounts used.

populationEvidence.title: Population registered in RNPP
populationEvidence.unavailable: Municipality absent from this extract: no estimated value is displayed.
populationEvidence.scope: Administrative extract from the national register of natural persons published by CTIE. The total adds adults and minors of both sexes. This differs from STATEC resident-population statistics. No income, employment rate, density or growth rate is inferred from this extract.
populationEvidence.source: Official CTIE / RNPP source — CC0 licence

officialPriceIndex.scope: National annual averages, new and existing dwellings purchased by households. Published observations from 2015 to 2025, with no 2026 forecast. The national index does not measure changes in a particular municipality or property.
officialPriceIndex.pageScope: Eurostat national series and municipal transaction averages from the Housing Observatory. The gap between asking and recorded prices is neither a time trend, a negotiable discount nor a measure of market health.
officialPriceIndex.communesScope: Existing apartments: recorded average prices per m², with periods shown for each row. Unpublished values remain missing, not zero. A simple average of municipalities is not the national average price. The CSV contains the selected observations, without estimating missing values.

marketEvidence.title: Published observations
marketEvidence.scope: Averages from separate samples: asking prices are not a transaction median. Their gap with recorded prices measures neither a time trend nor a negotiable discount. No valuation range or market-quality score is inferred from these observations.
marketEvidence.ratioScope: The gross rent/price ratio combines average asking rent × 12 and average recorded price per m², for different properties. It is not the return on a specific investment and deducts no vacancy, running costs, works, fees or taxes.

publishedMarket.title: Property market observations
publishedMarket.scope: Periods and coverage differ by source. Public residential data are distinguished from commercial benchmarks published by a private adviser. No benchmark is an appraisal of a specific property.
publishedMarket.noAggregate: Municipalities remain separate, without a national average calculated from their means. Off-plan apartments are not houses. Unpublished values remain blank in numeric exports.
publishedMarket.officeScope: Offices: Cushman & Wakefield benchmarks for Q2 2026. Take-up measures new occupier activity under the report’s definition; it is not sales volume. Prime rents are headline rents for high-quality properties, excluding incentives, not average rents. The long-term prime yield is a market benchmark, not the return of a particular asset.
publishedMarket.retailScope: Retail: Cushman & Wakefield benchmarks for H1 2026. Prime rents describe retail segments, not every address or shopping centre. Take-up is transacted occupier space, not space sold. These figures are not averages of rents actually paid.
publishedMarket.landScope: Land: historical observations from report 19, published on 10 October 2025. Retained sales cover undeveloped building land, mainly in residential or mixed-use zones. The 2022–2024 change comes from a hedonic index; it does not provide a current price per are or municipality.
publishedMarket.unavailableTitle: No verified figure displayed for this scope
publishedMarket.logisticsScope: No rent or stock series by area is available here with a verified source and period. For a logistics asset, use documented comparables and its lease data.
publishedMarket.macroScope: When comparing lending rates, check the period, contract type and observed population. The links below provide access to the producing institutions’ series; they do not constitute a financing offer.

constructionBudget.title: Documented construction budget
constructionBudget.scope: Build a budget from your quotes and identified assumptions. Enter all prices including VAT in euros. No tariff, professional fee or energy premium is assumed.
constructionBudget.surfaceScope: This area is used only to calculate the budget per m². It does not multiply the line items: each line uses its own quantity. Leaving it blank leaves this ratio uncalculated.
constructionBudget.lineScope: Add the works and fees included in your scope. For a lump-sum quote, enter quantity 1 and its VAT-inclusive amount. Avoid counting both a total quote and its component items. A blank field is not zero.
constructionBudget.label: Line description
constructionBudget.reference: Quote reference, date or documented assumption
constructionBudget.contingencyScope: Declared rate, initially zero. It applies only to the works subtotal, excluding additional fees. It is neither a quote nor a guarantee of the final cost.
constructionBudget.reason: Reason for a contingency above zero
constructionBudget.invalid: Complete at least one line: description, reference, positive quantity (up to 4 decimals) and non-negative VAT-inclusive price (up to 2 decimals). Any entered area must be positive. Contingency must be 0–100%, with a reason when positive.
constructionBudget.partial: This total covers only the entered items. Add land, acquisition costs, studies, professional fees, connections and financing as additional fees where needed. No grant or VAT recovery is automatically deducted.
constructionBudget.indexScope: The STATEC index measures price changes in residential construction, excluding VAT and land. It is not a quote or a universal price per m². No unit cost on this page is attributed to STATEC or Batiprix.

vrdBudget.title: Documented civil works budget and quantities
vrdBudget.scope: Price road and utility works using documented quantities and VAT-inclusive prices. The nine suggested lots are classification aids, with no integrated Batiprix, CTG or Creos tariff. Slope, soil conditions and transport distances must be reflected in your quotes; no multiplier is added automatically.
vrdBudget.geometryScope: Area = length × width. Volume = length × width × thickness in cm / 100, rounded to four decimals. This geometric calculation does not design roads, pipes or basins. It does not account for bulking, compaction, losses or excavated material reuse.
vrdBudget.label: Measured item name
vrdBudget.transfer: Add this quantity to the schedule
vrdBudget.transferScope: The added item retains the dimensions in its label. Then enter the VAT-inclusive price and reference. Avoid entering the same item manually as well.

pdfActions.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the window. Allow pop-ups for this site or use download.
pdfActions.failed: The PDF could not be generated. Try again; your inputs remain on the page.
pdfActions.signInScope: Sign in or create an account to preview and download your reports.

developmentAppraisal.title: Documented development appraisal
developmentAppraisal.scope: Enter project revenue, costs and target profit. Amounts are in euros, excluding recoverable VAT and including non-recoverable VAT. No market price or financing rate is assumed.
developmentAppraisal.name: Project name
developmentAppraisal.acquisitionReference: Acquisition cost reference, including zero amounts
developmentAppraisal.label: Description
developmentAppraisal.invalid: Complete amounts and references. Revenue must be positive; explicit zero amounts are accepted, negative amounts are not. Maximum two decimal places.
developmentAppraisal.residualBudget: Budget available for land and proportional costs
developmentAppraisal.unfunded: Negative residual budget: no positive land price meets the target.
developmentAppraisal.maximumBudgetDeficit: Maximum budget deficit under this payment order
developmentAppraisal.timingScope: Monthly costs are assumed paid before receipts. Acquisition costs occur in the land purchase month. This budget balance does not calculate credit drawdowns, equity contributions or bank cash flow with VAT timing. Enter planned interest and commissions as financing lines.
developmentAppraisal.taxScope: Use a consistent tax basis throughout: exclude only VAT that is actually recoverable and include non-recoverable VAT. Tax rates, duties, refunds and income taxes are not calculated automatically.
developmentAppraisal.costScope: Include all project costs: works, studies, insurance, sales, management, finance and contingencies. Missing categories are not estimated. No professional fee percentage or public grant is added.
developmentAppraisal.residualScope: The residual calculation deducts costs, target profit and fixed acquisition costs, then divides a positive balance by 1 + the proportional acquisition cost rate. The price is rounded down to cents. Negative balances remain visible. This is a budget capacity based on your assumptions, not a certified market valuation.
developmentAppraisal.importError: Invalid or incompatible dossier: current data is preserved.
developmentAppraisal.vefaSource: Off-plan sales and construction progress — Guichet.lu
developmentAppraisal.saveScope: The JSON file contains all inputs needed to resume this appraisal. Older incomplete scenarios are neither imported nor erased.
developmentAppraisal.outflows: Monthly costs, including land and acquisition

agriculturalEvidence.title: Agricultural land — documented calculation
agriculturalEvidence.scope: Calculate an amount from a supported price per hectare, building contributions and costs. No regional price, lease discount, demolition or asbestos cost is assumed.
agriculturalEvidence.priceReference: Source, date and rationale for the selected price
agriculturalEvidence.demolitionReference: Demolition quote or reason for zero
agriculturalEvidence.remediationReference: Remediation quote or reason for zero
agriculturalEvidence.rightsReference: Rights valued, lease, planning and selected tax basis
agriculturalEvidence.landValue: Land amount from the entered price
agriculturalEvidence.invalid: Enter the area, amounts and all references. Area must be positive; costs may be explicitly zero.
agriculturalEvidence.referenceScope: Agricultural land transactions by farmers; non-agricultural uses excluded. These national figures are not local prices or an appraisal of your plot. The combined median is not the average of the two columns.
agriculturalEvidence.referenceFees: Series note: excluding VAT, including notarial fees; since 2015, VAT on notarial fees is included. Do not mix this basis with a land price excluding fees.
agriculturalEvidence.referenceDate: Stated publication: 23 August 2025. Retrieved: 9 September 2026. Last year in this series: 2024.
agriculturalEvidence.rightsScope: Rural leases, easements, the PAG and permits require plot-specific review. A lease or cessation of farming triggers neither a fixed discount nor an automatic demolition requirement here. Distinguish retained buildings from demolished buildings to avoid double counting.
agriculturalEvidence.formula: Area × price per hectare + retained buildings − demolition − remediation. Enter costs on the tax basis you describe; no tax or grant is added automatically.

hotelOperatingEvidence.title: Documented hotel operating statement
hotelOperatingEvidence.scope: Enter revenue and expenses for a period of 1 to 366 days. No ancillary revenue, expense, growth or performance benchmark is assumed.
hotelOperatingEvidence.name: Hotel / dossier
hotelOperatingEvidence.capacityReference: Capacity, closures and rooms sold reference
hotelOperatingEvidence.accountingReference: Accounting / VAT basis and supporting records
hotelOperatingEvidence.label: Description
hotelOperatingEvidence.invalid: Complete capacity, period and references. Every category requires an amount, including supported zero. Missing or inconsistent data produces no result.
hotelOperatingEvidence.capacityScope: Enter available capacity, capped at rooms × inclusive calendar days. Sold room-nights cannot exceed it. Zero availability leaves per-available-room ratios undefined; zero sales leaves ADR undefined.
hotelOperatingEvidence.costScope: Enter payroll, including employer contributions, once in its dedicated categories; exclude it from other expenses. Document every category, including absent ones with zero. Non-operating expenses may include rent, property insurance and property taxes; exclude interest, income taxes, depreciation, amortisation and FF&E reserve. Use a consistent VAT basis.
hotelOperatingEvidence.resultScope: GOP = departmental profit − general expenses. EBITDA = GOP − management fees + non-operating income − non-operating expenses. The reserve is deducted afterwards. This simplified statement is not USALI certification, a benchmark or net profit after financing and income tax.

hotelValueEvidence.title: Documented hotel valuation
hotelValueEvidence.scope: Two separate calculations: capitalisation of supported annual income and comparison of transaction prices per room. No rate, price per room or weighting between methods is assumed.
hotelValueEvidence.name: Hotel / dossier
hotelValueEvidence.rightsReference: Rights, asset scope and basis of value
hotelValueEvidence.incomeScope: Income and rate must relate to the same rights and scope: leased property, operated property or property/business combination. Income ÷ rate is direct capitalisation; it projects neither annual cash flows nor terminal value.
hotelValueEvidence.comparisonScope: Enter identified transactions dated no later than the valuation date. Explain differences in scope, location, condition and sale terms. Weights are normalised across your selection; capitalisation and comparison are not automatically averaged.
hotelValueEvidence.invalid: Complete inputs and references for selected methods. Room counts must be whole numbers, rates positive and weights not all zero.
hotelValueEvidence.noIncomeValue: Annual income is zero or negative: direct capitalisation does not provide a usable positive value here. This does not mean the property is worthless.
hotelValueEvidence.rightsScope: Specify included assets: real estate, furniture, business, contracts and occupancy rights. Enterprise value is not automatically the value of the real estate alone. This calculation documents assumptions and is not professional certification.

hotelCoverageEvidence.title: Documented hotel debt coverage
hotelCoverageEvidence.scope: Fixed-rate amortising loan, monthly payments and declared annual available cash flow. No bank threshold, credit refusal or downside scenario is assumed.
hotelCoverageEvidence.name: Hotel / dossier
hotelCoverageEvidence.annualCash: Annual cash available for debt service (€)
hotelCoverageEvidence.loanScope: End-of-month payments, without grace periods, floating rates, prepayment or balloon. Annualised service represents 12 payments and recurring costs; the schedule uses months actually due, including a partial final period. Upfront fees are separate from recurring service. Calculations retain precision before display to cents; contractual value dates and rounding may differ.
hotelCoverageEvidence.cashScope: The numerator is cash actually available for debt service under the stated scope: explain included taxes, working capital and investments. EBITDA is not substituted automatically. The schedule assumes uniform constant cash flow, prorated by months.
hotelCoverageEvidence.targetScope: The entered threshold is a dossier assumption. Capacity solves the same payment model, after recurring costs, to meet that threshold; it is neither a loan offer nor a bank decision. LTV uses documented property value, not total project cost.
hotelCoverageEvidence.invalid: Complete amounts and references. Missing data is not zero. Zero debt has no DSCR; loan costs must then be zero.

hotelAcquisitionEvidence.title: Documented hotel acquisition
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.name: File name
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.source: RICS: method selection and transparent assumptions
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.scope: Cash flow analysis of an acquisition project. No market price, sector multiple, growth or purchase score is assumed. Each amount and year requires supporting evidence.
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.entryScope: Initial equity equals price, costs and initial investment less the loan. Include duties, financing fees and non-recoverable taxes in documented costs without duplication. Debt cannot exceed the initial requirement.
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.loanScope: Fixed loan with end-of-month payments, fully drawn at acquisition, without grace period or refinancing. Recurring costs stop at maturity. Calculations retain full precision; contractual conventions and rounding may differ.
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.exitScope: Exit occurs after the cash flow of the final entered year. Its price is a documented assumption, not a calculated market value. Net proceeds deduct entered costs, taxes and principal outstanding after that year’s payments.
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.cashScope: Enter 1 to 30 complete years with year-end cash flows: receipts less expenses, taxes, working capital changes and capital expenditure, before debt. Do not automatically use EBITDA. Taxes and investment are not separately calculated here. No cash flow or growth is extrapolated. DSCR compares annual cash with debt service actually paid that year, including loans maturing during the year.
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.returnScope: Negative annual net cash flows are additional contributions; positive flows are distributions, including exit. The multiple divides distributions by all contributions without adding initial equity again. NPV discounts equity cash flows at the entered rate. IRR is unavailable without a negative initial contribution, for multiple sign changes, or without a root in the calculation range. Results do not constitute credit approval or a purchase recommendation.
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.invalid: Complete amounts, including zeros, and references. Check funding, the whole-month term and every annual cash flow.
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.importError: Incomplete, incompatible or invalid file: the current scenario is preserved.
hotelAcquisitionEvidence.storage: Save JSON to resume after closing. Legacy local acquisition data remains in your browser but is not used by this documented model.

e2Evidence.title: E‑2 evidence file — principal investor
e2Evidence.name: File name
e2Evidence.nationalityHelp: Check the applicant’s nationality, applicable E‑2 treaty and any rules specific to their circumstances. Residence in Luxembourg alone does not establish the required nationality.
e2Evidence.ownershipHelp: Document the ownership chain: at least 50% of the enterprise must be owned by nationals of the relevant treaty country. Distinguish this from the investor’s personal ability to direct.
e2Evidence.fundsHelp: Trace legitimate origin, possession and control of capital. Document loans and security: debt secured by enterprise assets does not count as the investor’s at-risk capital.
e2Evidence.commitmentHelp: Support expenditure or irrevocable commitments and exposure to commercial loss. Funds merely available in a bank account are insufficient. Escrow conditions require examination.
e2Evidence.enterpriseHelp: Document a real, credible US commercial activity: contracts, premises, permits, operations or concrete launch steps. A passive investment alone is insufficient.
e2Evidence.substantialHelp: Assess qualifying capital against the actual enterprise cost and requirements for success. No universal minimum amount or automatic 30%, 50% or 75% threshold determines this condition.
e2Evidence.nonMarginalHelp: Document present or future capacity to exceed minimal living for the investor and family, or make a significant economic contribution. Future capacity should generally be achievable within five years of normal operations starting. No automatic five-job threshold is applied here.
e2Evidence.controlHelp: Demonstrate control to develop and direct through ownership or other effective management rights. A job title without documented powers does not establish control.
e2Evidence.departureHelp: Document intent to leave the United States when E‑2 status ends. Distinguish visa validity from the authorized period of stay.
e2Evidence.scope: Prepare evidence for a principal E‑2 investor in the United States. Statuses describe your documentation, without an eligibility opinion or probability calculation.
e2Evidence.limits: This preparation list does not cover every admission requirement or employee and family applications. Check the competent consulate’s instructions and obtain an individual review. Sources checked on 9 September 2026.
e2Evidence.noVerdict: Even with all evidence entered, no favorable opinion or visa approval is inferred. “Evidence entered” only means a reference was provided; Tevaxia has not checked its contents.
e2Evidence.invalid: Add a reference for every “Evidence entered” status, or choose another status.
e2Evidence.importError: Invalid or incompatible file: the current file is preserved.
e2Evidence.storage: Save JSON to resume after closing. This page does not send documents or submit a visa application.

authGate.title: View details
authGate.description: Sign in or create a free account to view the details.

hotelCompsetEvidence.title: Documented hotel comparison
hotelCompsetEvidence.selectionReference: Evidence for hotel selection and a common basis
hotelCompsetEvidence.subject: Subject hotel (one only)
hotelCompsetEvidence.name: Hotel name
hotelCompsetEvidence.source: CoStar / STR: ADR, occupancy, RevPAR and index definitions
hotelCompsetEvidence.scope: Compare documented observations over a common period of 1 to 366 days. No STR, Horwath or regional averages are prefilled. Results describe only the entered sample, whose relevance needs justification.
hotelCompsetEvidence.basis: Use room revenue in euros excluding VAT on the same accounting basis throughout: exclude food, beverage and other revenue. Availability must be consistent for closures and out-of-service rooms; do not use guest nights. Dates apply to every hotel; available volumes may reflect documented closures.
hotelCompsetEvidence.aggregation: ADR = total room revenue / total sold room nights. Occupancy = sold / available. RevPAR = revenue / available. Aggregates use underlying volumes rather than simple averages of individual ratios. The subject hotel is excluded from this sample.
hotelCompsetEvidence.indexScope: ARI = subject ADR / competitor ADR × 100; MPI = subject occupancy / competitor occupancy × 100; RGI = subject RevPAR / competitor RevPAR × 100. An index requires a subject hotel and a positive competitor denominator. Unavailable values remain “—”, not zero.
hotelCompsetEvidence.invalid: Enter dates, references and amounts, including zeros. At least one competitor and at most one subject are required; sold ≤ available ≤ rooms × days. Positive room revenue without sold room nights is not accepted.
hotelCompsetEvidence.importError: Incomplete or incompatible file: current data is preserved.
hotelCompsetEvidence.storage: Save JSON to resume after closing. Entered sources are not automatically verified; this page does not provide or collect private STR data.

hotelTourismEvidence.title: Hotel activity in Luxembourg — Eurostat
hotelTourismEvidence.changePct: Change over the same months of the previous year
hotelTourismEvidence.source_nights: Eurostat tour_occ_nim: nights, hotels and similar
hotelTourismEvidence.source_arrivals: Eurostat tour_occ_arm: arrivals, hotels and similar
hotelTourismEvidence.scope: Official monthly series for Luxembourg: hotels and similar accommodation (NACE I55.1), residents and non-residents combined. National data describes neither an individual hotel nor a star category.
hotelTourismEvidence.units: A guest night counts one person staying for one night; it is not a sold room night. Arrivals count arrivals at establishments, not unique visitors to the country. These series cannot produce ADR or RevPAR.
hotelTourismEvidence.totalsScope: {months} months with published guest nights. An incomplete year remains a partial cumulative total; missing values are not replaced by zero.
hotelTourismEvidence.changeScope: The change compares exactly the months with available guest-night data against the same months of the preceding year. It remains unavailable if that comparison is incomplete. A partial total is never compared with a full year.
hotelTourismEvidence.occupancyScope: Occupancy is the official monthly bedroom series (BEDRM), distinct from bed-place occupancy. No simple monthly average is presented as an annual rate. Missing months remain unpublished.
hotelTourismEvidence.limits: Publications may be revised. No star-category breakdown, detailed visitor origins, ADR estimate or forecast is reconstructed from these series.

hotelPublishedDeals.title: Published hotel transactions — European selection
hotelPublishedDeals.scope: Limited selection of transactions identified in releases by the parties, checked on 9 September 2026. Each amount retains its published scope. This selection does not measure Luxembourg or Greater Region market volume.
hotelPublishedDeals.limits: Approximate amounts are not appraisal values. Uncorroborated prices, category averages and implied capitalisation rates from the previous table are not retained. No market total is inferred from these examples.
hotelPublishedDeals.antwerpScope: Pandox disposal: approximately €19 million for the hotel property and operations, with 262 rooms. Completion announced on 2 February 2026; agreement announced on 2 December 2025.
hotelPublishedDeals.cologneScope: Pandox acquisition of a hotel property leased to AccorInvest: approximately €66 million including stamp duty, with 275 rooms. Agreement on 6 March 2025 and completion on 1 April 2025. This is not a property price excluding duties.
hotelPublishedDeals.ratioScope: The per-room ratio divides the approximate published amount by the rooms in that transaction. It retains duties and operations where included; it is not an adjusted comparable for another hotel.
hotelPublishedDeals.empty: No corroborated transaction is retained for this country in this selection. This does not mean that no transaction occurred there.

miceBudget.title: Documented MICE budget
miceBudget.scope: Scenario over 1 to 366 days. Enter expected volumes, prices and costs on the same tax basis. No market conversion rate, room sharing, margin or seasonality is imposed.
miceBudget.reference: Sources and assumptions: period, expected groups, volumes per group, food service unit definition, prices, costs and capacity available for MICE.
miceBudget.costScope: Costs per group are direct costs. Fixed costs cover additional or allocated costs of this scenario, without double counting. The balance is a contribution based on entered costs, not certified GOP, EBITDA or net profit.
miceBudget.invalid: Complete all inputs, including zeros, and references. Quantities: up to 4 decimals; euros: 2. Projected volumes must not exceed declared capacity.
miceBudget.availableMeetingDays: Meeting room days available for MICE

motelGuide.title: Motel and aparthotel: prepare your study
motelGuide.scope: Build operating accounts, valuation and financing using your own data. Property type does not automatically determine rates, costs or capitalization yields.
motelGuide.operatingBody: Enter the period, available and sold units, revenue by activity and actual or budgeted costs. A unit is what you sell for one night: a room or a whole apartment.
motelGuide.valueBody: Document the selected income, its scope and capitalization rate, or your comparable transactions. Operating profit does not automatically become net property income.
motelGuide.acquisitionBody: Enter the price, fees, works, debt and annual cash flows after relevant costs. Funding needs and exit price remain assumptions to document.
motelGuide.recordsBody: Room nights and availability, actual rates, breakfast and other service revenue, salaries and employer costs, contracts and invoices, maintenance and investment. Use a consistent basis for amounts including or excluding tax.
motelGuide.independent: Tools are independent: enter your data and references in each. Floor area, average stay and a kitchenette alone cannot determine profitability.

capexPlan.title: Documented CAPEX and funding plan
capexPlan.scope: Plan investment spending and funding over 1 to 30 consecutive years. Reserve deposits are available funding: they are not added to works as a second expense.
capexPlan.reference: Quotes, schedule, funding and tax basis; document zeros too.
capexPlan.timing: Balances are calculated at annual close, without automatic interest or inflation. Additional funding need is the largest closing deficit, not the sum of deficits. No corrective cash injection is assumed. Payment timing within the year may create a larger need.
capexPlan.invalid: Enter consecutive years (2000–2099), all nonnegative amounts to the cent and supporting references.
capexPlan.additionalFunding: Maximum additional need at annual close (€)

greenKeyFile.title: Prepare Green Key evidence
greenKeyFile.notice: Internal document register, without a score or eligibility decision. Referencing evidence does not establish conformity. Certification follows the official assessment and decision process.
greenKeyFile.transition: Two criteria sets are published. Confirm the version, category and transition arrangements with the programme contact.
greenKeyFile.source_contact: Join and find the appropriate contact
greenKeyFile.name: Establishment
greenKeyFile.scope: Category, scope and confirmation reference for the applicable criteria
greenKeyFile.instructions: Record criterion numbers from the selected version. This register is not an exhaustive checklist. Evidence, issues and non-applicability require justification; statuses remain your declarations.
greenKeyFile.criterion: Criterion number and reference in the selected version
greenKeyFile.proof: Dated evidence, document location or justification for review
greenKeyFile.invalid: To export, enter the establishment, version, scope and each criterion reference. Justify every status other than “not reviewed”.

latePayment.title: Documented late payment interest
latePayment.scope: One invoice, unchanged principal, no partial payments or compounding. No assumed rate, fees or recovery prospect. Blank fields are unknown: enter zero for a confirmed nil amount.
latePayment.legal: Conditions and rates differ between commercial transactions and consumers. The commercial EUR 40 flat fee does not automatically apply to every customer. Check entitlement to interest and costs in official sources.
latePayment.reference: Documents, enforceability, absence of partial payments and cost basis (zero if none)
latePayment.datesScope: First and last days included; start on the first day interest is due, not the invoice date. Consecutive segments with no gaps or overlaps, each within one half-year. Split at every rate change. 365-day basis, simple interest rounded to cents per segment.
latePayment.rateReference: Rate source and basis for this segment’s dates
latePayment.invalid: Provide all sources and values. Valid dates 2000–2099, consecutive segments within one half-year, rates 0–100% (4 decimals), amounts EUR 0–1 billion (2 decimals).
latePayment.resultScope: This total establishes neither legal enforceability, reimbursement of costs nor recovery probability. This model is unsuitable for partial payments or changing principal.
latePayment.sources: Official references: check conditions and the rate for each period.

housekeepingPlan.title: Daily housekeeping plan
housekeepingPlan.scope: Calculate one day’s workload from actual planned departure and stayover cleaning. No invented occupancy or weekly pattern. Blank fields are unknown; zero is an explicit value.
housekeepingPlan.timeScope: The room categories are distinct, each counted once. Productive minutes exclude breaks, travel and other tasks and cannot exceed paid hours × 60. Agent requirements are rounded up to whole shifts.
housekeepingPlan.costScope: Enter documented full employer costs and paid time. Supervisors are added separately and do not contribute cleaning minutes. No assumed supervision ratio or wage uplift.
housekeepingPlan.reference: Planning source, observed times, employer costs and task scope (maximum 3,000 characters)
housekeepingPlan.invalid: Complete all fields and sources. Integer counts 0–100,000; other non-negative values to two decimals. Tasks require positive time and productive capacity; rooms to clean cannot exceed available rooms. Daily hours ≤ 24.
housekeepingPlan.resultScope: Cost includes all paid shift hours and entered supervisors. Ratios with no rooms in the denominator remain unknown. This workload calculation does not validate schedules, working conditions or statutory staffing; adapt the plan to actual constraints.

yieldRules.title: Saved hotel thresholds
yieldRules.scope: This screen stores rules. It does not evaluate metrics or send notifications. Automatic monitoring and email/push delivery are not confirmed here. New rules are disabled by default, with notifications off.
yieldRules.error: The operation could not be completed. Your changes are not confirmed.
yieldRules.manual: For an immediate check, manually compare documented data and periods using these tools.
yieldRules.historyScope: Displayed status and preferences are stored settings, not evidence of monitoring or delivery. Existing rules are retained.
yieldRules.activeField: Enable the rule setting (does not confirm monitoring)
yieldRules.validation: Two-decimal thresholds: occupancy 0–100%, other deviations 0–999.99%, GOP margin −999.99 to 999.99%. Integer window 1–366 days. Define reference data separately; no benchmark is supplied here.

hotelMarketing.title: Hotel tools and documented data
hotelMarketing.description: Valuation, debt coverage, operations and evidence files: work from your figures and sources with explicit assumptions.
hotelMarketing.publicList: Hotel tools: documented valuation, debt coverage, operations, E-2 preparation, forecasts from supplied history, sourced comparisons, MICE, CAPEX and published transactions.
hotelMarketing.groupList: Hotel group: saved files and periods, declared-data PDF reports, period comparison and threshold settings. Automatic alert monitoring is not confirmed.
hotelMarketing.pmsDesc: The PMS area contains property and reservation management screens. Analysis tools use their own inputs and sources; no automatic transfer to the group is assumed.
hotelMarketing.projectDesc: Document price, cash flows, costs, funding and comparison sources. The due diligence file gathers your evidence and observations; it is not legal or technical approval.
hotelMarketing.setupDesc: Enter rooms and property settings. Check rates, tax treatment and any local taxes before use; no setup duration is guaranteed.
hotelMarketing.operateDesc: Check reservations, charges, rates and supporting documents before producing an invoice or report. Stored data alone does not establish tax or accounting validity.
hotelMarketing.multiDesc: Group files contain user-entered periods. They do not automatically consolidate PMS reservations or KPIs. Compare identical periods in the benchmark.
hotelMarketing.calendarDesc: Check the import/export functions offered for your property and how the destination channel works. An iCal calendar guarantees neither immediate updates nor freedom from overbooking; check rates and payments separately.
hotelMarketing.taxDesc: The rate depends on the service and VAT Act schedules. F&B does not determine one universal rate. Check each line and any local tax against applicable sources.
hotelMarketing.greenDesc: The Green Key file references criteria and evidence for the selected version. It does not calculate eligibility or issue certification. Confirm the procedure with Green Key.
hotelMarketing.ctaDesc: Open your account and enter property data. Check offer terms for features and access limits.
hotelMarketing.guideDesc: The hotel suite provides documented valuation and funding scenarios, sourced tourism observations and an acquisition file. No score guarantees value, financing or an E-2 visa.
hotelMarketing.ddDesc: Reference evidence, reservations and points to review before a transaction.
hotelMarketing.valueDesc: Enter documented income, rate and comparables to build a scenario.
hotelMarketing.coverageDesc: Compare available cash flow against an explicit debt schedule.
hotelMarketing.e2Desc: Gather project evidence and relevant references without an eligibility score.
hotelMarketing.operatingDesc: Enter revenue and cost categories; distinguish GOP, EBITDA and reserves.
hotelMarketing.groupDesc: Save property periods and export declared data.
hotelMarketing.scope: Results depend on supplied data and each tool’s scope. Reports and files do not certify USALI, tax or banking compliance or administrative eligibility.

pmsJournal.title: PMS monthly journal
pmsJournal.description: Recorded folio postings and inventory snapshots.
pmsJournal.scope: UTC posting period, including the first day and excluding the first day of the following month. Voided lines are excluded. Recorded amounts may concern stays in other months and folios not yet invoiced or paid. This journal is not a USALI profit and loss account, VAT return or accounting close.
pmsJournal.inventoryScope: Inventory covers only days with a snapshot. Missing days are not extrapolated. Recorded counts are not certified; closed refers to the PMS snapshot status. Estimated audit revenue and folio postings use different bases: no ADR, RevPAR, TRevPAR or annual comparison is derived by mixing them.
pmsJournal.error: Reading failed or data is inconsistent. No partial total is shown.
pmsJournal.downloadError: The PDF could not be created. Please retry.
pmsJournal.empty: No non-voided postings in this period.
pmsJournal.pdfScope: Recorded data without accounting or tax validation. Tourism tax is separate. Historical lines and rates are not recalculated.

pmsChargeEntry.title: Add a documented charge
pmsChargeEntry.scope: Enter the net price and tax rate applicable to the actual service. A category does not determine VAT: Annex B distinguishes restaurant services from the portion relating to alcoholic drinks. For a zero rate, state the treatment and its reference. No price or rate is prefilled.
pmsChargeEntry.reference: Price reference and justification of VAT treatment
pmsChargeEntry.invalid: Complete every field and its reference. Positive quantity, non-negative price and at most two decimal places; rate from 0 to 99.99%.
pmsChargeEntry.error: Unable to save. Your draft is retained; check the folio and retry.
pmsChargeEntry.openFolioFirst: Open the reservation folio to check its status or create a folio before entering charges.

pmsStatement.title: Folio statement
pmsStatement.scope: Snapshot of the active recorded charges. This statement is neither an issued invoice, a payment receipt nor a Factur-X file. No invoice number or payment due date is created.
pmsStatement.amountScope: Historical amounts are copied without recalculating VAT. Recorded visitor tax remains included in the charge totals. The recorded balance does not prove payment; a zero rate alone does not establish the tax treatment.
pmsStatement.error: The statement could not be generated. Reload the charges and try again.

pmsInvoiceRecord.title: PMS document record
pmsInvoiceRecord.scope: Reproduction of recorded data using the property’s current contact details. This record does not replace the archived original and is not an invoice issuance, receipt or tax validation.
pmsInvoiceRecord.amountScope: Amounts are recorded category aggregates, not a breakdown of services by tax rate. No VAT is recalculated; tax treatment and supporting documents still require verification.
pmsInvoiceRecord.downloadError: Unable to generate the record: check the recorded amounts and retry.

billingPreparation.title: Prepare billing documents
billingPreparation.subtitle: Enter parties, services and amounts, then check your documents before issuing and sending them.
billingPreparation.scope: Preparing a file does not issue it, validate its tax treatment or send it to the recipient.
billingPreparation.dataBody: You enter references, dates, identities and rates. A business template does not determine the applicable tax treatment.
billingPreparation.calculationBody: Discounts, net amounts, VAT by category and rate, then gross totals: calculations use the entered lines and their rounding to cents.
billingPreparation.exportBody: Download a paginated PDF and its CII XML. Validate the file with your billing solution and keep the original actually sent.
billingPreparation.frBody: Businesses within scope must receive electronic invoices from 1 September 2026. The DGFiP provides the issuing timetable and approved platforms.
billingPreparation.luBody: For public procurement and concession contracts within scope, use Peppol or MyGuichet.lu to send a compliant invoice through the official procedure.
billingPreparation.metaDescription: Prepare billing data, rounded amounts, paginated PDF and CII XML for checking before transmission.

invoiceDraft.readError: The saved draft could not be loaded. Keep a copy before resetting.
invoiceDraft.saveError: The draft could not be saved in this browser.
invoiceDraft.legacy: An old draft not linked to an account exists on this device.
invoiceDraft.legacyConfirm: This draft may belong to another user of this device. Confirm it is yours before replacing the current draft.

invoiceTemplate.scope: Templates prepare line labels. Enter prices, VAT category and rate according to the service and applicable tax treatment. Assign a number from your own invoicing sequence.

insuranceBudget.title: Rent default insurance: compare your quotes
insuranceBudget.intro: Enter annual premiums from quotes you received to compare their cost. No insurer tariff, ranking or indemnity guarantee is generated.
insuranceBudget.scopeNote: Quotes must cover the same set of properties. Rent and charges below are monthly averages per property; each premium covers the whole set, including fees and taxes.
insuranceBudget.ratio: Premium / annual rent and charges base
insuranceBudget.invalid: Check amounts: nonnegative with at most two decimals; property count must be an integer from 1 to 500.
insuranceBudget.calculationNote: Annual base = (rent + charges) × properties × 12. Monthly equivalent = annual premium ÷ 12, rounded only for display; it is not the insurer’s payment schedule. The percentage measures cost, not coverage quality. No entered quote means no calculated price.
insuranceBudget.checkScope: Check which properties, tenants, rent and charges are actually insured in each quote.
insuranceBudget.checkLimits: Compare monthly, annual and per-claim limits, coverage duration, deductibles and waiting periods.
insuranceBudget.checkEligibility: Read the contract-specific eligibility conditions, exclusions and disclosure obligations.
insuranceBudget.checkClaims: Check claim notification deadlines, required evidence, legal protection and coverage conditions.
insuranceBudget.sourcesNote: Examples of official pages consulted on 10 September 2026. Non-exhaustive list, without recommendations or quoted tariffs; the terms of your own quote govern.

rentalFiscalWorksheet.title: Rental income tax preparation
rentalFiscalWorksheet.intro: Worksheet for privately held property using actual expenses. Enter tax-qualified receipts and expenses after checking your documents; no tax or filing amount is certified.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.draftNote: Entries remain in this session, separated by year and account. They are not saved to the cloud and are lost when you close or reload this page. Download the draft to retain a copy.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.netNote: Selected receipts minus entered expenses. Losses are preserved. The total remains incomplete while any property has an empty or invalid field.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.empty: No cloud properties available for this account.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.sourceNote: These amounts use the declared payment date, without bank confirmation or automatic tax-year allocation. Reconcile them with your statements.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.partialNote: {n} partial entry/entries in the ledger: determine payment amounts and years separately.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.crossYearNote: {n} entry/entries relevant to this year have different rent and payment years: review tax-year allocation.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.receipts: Tax-qualified receipts for this property and year (€)
rentalFiscalWorksheet.receiptsNote: Enter the verified amount, including other relevant receipts. Charge advances are not added automatically.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.zeroExpenses: Set remaining empty expense fields to zero
rentalFiscalWorksheet.invalid: Invalid amount: enter a nonnegative amount with at most two decimals.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.timing: Review allocation of periodic rent received around the turn of the year.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.chargesNote: Qualify charge advances, reconciliations and reimbursements to the landlord.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.investment: Distinguish maintenance from investment; establish the depreciation base and rate separately, excluding land.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.regime: This worksheet does not calculate flat-rate regimes, exemptions, corporate tax or social rental management.
rentalFiscalWorksheet.signIn: Sign in to prepare rental data
rentalFiscalWorksheet.loading: Loading complete property and payment records…
rentalFiscalWorksheet.loadError: Complete data could not be loaded. No partial total is presented.

socialRentalAudit.title: Social rental management: dated scenario
socialRentalAudit.intro: Compare two net rental income assumptions. Partial exemption concerns income from approved organisations; it does not automatically apply to every rental described as social.
socialRentalAudit.exemption: Exemption of {rate}% of eligible net income in {year}
socialRentalAudit.rateNote: Verified rates: 50% for 2017–2022, 75% in 2023, 90% for 2024–2026. No future rate is assumed.
socialRentalAudit.inputNote: Enter the proposed rents and tax-qualified annual expenses separately. No rent discount, expenses or tax profile is prefilled.
socialRentalAudit.eligible: I have verified that social scenario income meets the exemption conditions for this year through an approved organisation.
socialRentalAudit.invalid: Nonnegative amounts with at most two decimals; rate between 0 and 100%.
socialRentalAudit.estimateTitle: Estimate at the entered marginal rate
socialRentalAudit.standardAfterTax: Estimated net income after tax — standard
socialRentalAudit.socialAfterTax: Estimated net income after tax — social
socialRentalAudit.difference: Social minus standard estimated after-tax income
socialRentalAudit.notReady: Enter assumptions and confirm eligibility to show the estimate. If either scenario has a loss, net income remains visible but its tax treatment is not simulated.
socialRentalAudit.estimateNote: Net income = monthly rent × 12 − qualified annual expenses. The estimate applies a constant rate, without progressive bands, other income or family circumstances. It is not a complete tax or cash-flow calculation. A negative difference means lower estimated net income in the social scenario.
socialRentalAudit.conditions: Contact an organisation in the official directory. Confirm rent, duration, property availability, services and acceptance criteria. No automatic energy-class exclusion or universal contract duration is applied here.
socialRentalAudit.sourceDate: Official sources consulted on 10 September 2026. The ministry maintains the directory; no commercial Tevaxia partnership is claimed.

marketThresholds.title: Track {commune}
marketThresholds.manualNotice: Manual tracking: only the threshold is saved. Automatic notifications are not offered here. Check the municipality page regularly.
marketThresholds.login: Sign in to save a threshold
marketThresholds.optionalTarget: Optional: leave blank to track the municipality without a target price.
marketThresholds.loadFailed: Unable to load. Reload before changing this tracking entry.
marketThresholds.saveFailed: Change not confirmed. Reload to check the saved state before trying again.
marketThresholds.invalidTarget: Enter a non-negative price with up to two decimal places, or leave blank.
marketThresholds.duplicates: Several entries exist for this municipality. Manage them in your profile to choose which to keep.
marketThresholds.empty: No saved thresholds. You can add one from a municipality page.

accountExport.title: Export an account snapshot
accountExport.scope: Included: profile, this account’s local copies in this browser (including the valuation recovery bin), visible cloud valuations and rental lots, manual tracking, shared-link and API-key metadata, and stored plan. Local copies and cloud records are separate.
accountExport.limits: This file does not contain all your data: other browsers, unassigned legacy caches, other modules and workspaces, documents, invoices, secrets and shared-link contents are excluded. Successive reads are not a backup at one single point in time. For a wider request, contact contact@tevaxia.lu.
accountExport.error: The export could not be completed. No file was downloaded. Check your connection and account, then retry.
accountExport.done: Download started. Check your browser’s downloads for the file.

ownedLinks.title: Public shared links
ownedLinks.scope: Anyone with the link can view the shared copy. This list includes expired links and links that reached their limit. Counts reflect the last load; refresh to update them.
ownedLinks.error: Read or action not confirmed. Refresh before retrying; missing results are not treated as zero.
ownedLinks.confirm: Revoke this public link? Its access will be removed.
ownedLinks.detailScope: Views are not unique visitors. Opening a link may add a view. Details reflect the time they were loaded.

shareCreation.title: Prepare sharing
shareCreation.scope: Anyone with this link can view a copy of the calculation’s data and results without an account. Check the information before creating the link. Later calculation changes will not update this copy. Revoke access from your profile. The view cap does not guarantee a strict block on simultaneous openings.
shareCreation.views: View cap: blank for no cap, otherwise 1 to 1,000,000
shareCreation.invalid: Check the title, whole number of days and whole-number view cap. This invalid attempt did not create a link.
shareCreation.uncertain: Creation not confirmed. A link may have been saved: check your profile. Retrying with the same settings looks up the same link before creating a new one.
shareCreation.copyFailed: Copy not confirmed. You can select the link and copy it manually.
shareCreation.invalidPayload: These data cannot be shared: check the results and their size.
